We are looking for a skilled GoHighLevel AI Automation Specialist to help us build AI systems and automations across multiple businesses.



This will START as a PAID TEST PROJECT.



If you do a great job, there is an opportunity for ongoing part-time work and potentially a long-term position with our team.



WHAT WE ARE BUILDING



We are building an AI-powered system inside GoHighLevel for:



• Real Estate

• Credit Education / Credit Services

• Online Coaching & Community

• Lead Generation

• Sales Follow-Up

• CRM Management

• Content Creation

• AI Coaching



Long term, we want AI agents that can help:



• Qualify new leads

• Ask questions and save answers into custom fields

• Update opportunities and pipeline stages

• Tag and organize contacts

• Follow up with leads automatically

• Identify leads that have not been contacted

• Identify opportunities that have been sitting too long

• Book appointments

• Notify salespeople when human follow-up is needed

• Create daily CRM reports

• Help generate content and marketing ideas

• Connect AI tools with GoHighLevel

• Help build an AI Coach using our training materials and knowledge base

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, webhooks, APIs, and AI integrations



PAID TEST PROJECT



You will receive access to a TEST GoHighLevel sub-account.



You will NOT work inside our main live account during the test.



For the test, we want you to build a simple AI Real Estate Lead Qualification System.



Example:



New lead enters GoHighLevel



↓



AI starts the conversation



↓



AI asks qualification questions



↓



Answers are saved into the correct custom fields



↓



Contact is tagged correctly



↓



Opportunity is created or updated



↓



Lead is moved to the correct pipeline stage



↓



Team member receives an internal notification



↓



AI knows when to stop and hand the conversation over to a human



The system should be organized so that, if approved, we can reuse or implement the work in our live GoHighLevel system.



You must also provide a short Loom video explaining what you built, how it works, and how you would improve it.



WHO WE WANT



You should have real experience with:



• GoHighLevel

• Workflows and automations

• Conversation AI / AI Agents

• Pipelines and opportunities

• Custom fields and tags

• Forms and calendars

• Webhooks

• APIs

• AI prompting

• ChatGPT or similar AI platforms



BONUS SKILLS



Big plus if you have experience with:



• GoHighLevel MCP

• 

• n8n

• Zapier

• OpenAI API

• AI knowledge bases / RAG

• AI voice agents

• AI content creation

• Real estate CRM systems

• Building AI assistants or AI coaches



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



A short VOICE MESSAGE introducing yourself.



Tell me specifically about your GoHighLevel experience.



Tell me what AI agents or AI automations you have personally built.



Send examples, screenshots, Loom videos, or portfolio work showing systems YOU built.



Tell me which tools you know:

GoHighLevel, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Make, n8n, Zapier, MCP, APIs, webhooks, etc.



Tell me how you would approach the paid test project described above.



Tell me your hourly rate for ongoing work if you pass the test.



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words:



“AI GOAT”



If you do not start your application with “AI GOAT,” your application will not be reviewed.



We are NOT looking for someone who only knows how to create basic workflows.



We want someone who understands automation, AI, CRM systems, problem-solving, testing, and documentation.



If you do well on the paid test, we want to continue working with you to build our full AI system.



This can turn into a long-term opportunity for the right person.

title: Social Media Manager for a Health & Wellness Practice (Project-Based)
description:
Type of work: Project-based



Project rate: $400 USD per month



Start: on or before October 12



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a growing, US-based health and wellness practice looking for a detail-oriented Social Media Manager to handle our social media on a project basis, paid at a fixed monthly rate.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE EASY TO STEP INTO

Everything is already built: a complete SOP and weekly checklist, a content calendar system, a brand voice guide, and ready-made research lists. You'll also get a walkthrough video and a training call. Your job is execution and consistency, not building from scratch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Check comments and DMs daily (including weekends), and reply within 24 hours

A daily engagement block using our existing partner lists

Post daily on all platforms, including Instagram Stories

Prepare, get approval for, and schedule posts on each platform's native scheduler

Add new verified leads each week to our outreach lists

Update a weekly performance tracker (numbers only, no deep analysis)

A short monthly report, and plan the next month's content in advance



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

Have 1+ year of social media management experience (health, wellness, or parenting is a plus)

Are extremely detail-oriented and follow written processes exactly

Know Meta Business Suite, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, Canva, and Google Sheets

Communicate proactively and ask questions when unsure

* Ensure proper signal integrity, power distribution, and EMI considerations

* Generate manufacturing files (Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place)

* Review and validate designs for production readiness

* Collaborate on component selection and design optimization



**Requirements:**



* Proven experience in PCB design using KiCad

* Familiarity with Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 (CM4) hardware design guidelines

* Strong understanding of high-speed signals, power management, and PCB best practices

* Experience preparing designs for fabrication and assembly

* Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively



**Nice to Have:**



* Experience with CM4 carrier boards or similar embedded systems

* Knowledge of USB, HDMI, PCIe, and other high-speed interfaces

* Previous work with prototype-to-production workflows



**Duration:** Short-term (with potential extension)

title: Customer Success Specialist – SaaS
description:
We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and proactive Customer Success Specialist to join our growing Philippines-based SaaS company.



You’ll be one of the main points of contact for our customers — helping new customers understand the platform, answering questions, resolving support issues, and following up with prospects and existing customers.



This is a customer-facing role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers over video/phone as well as communicating through
 and support tickets.



What You'll Do



Handle incoming inquiries from prospective and existing customers



Conduct product demos and introductory calls with new customers



Help new customers get started and successfully onboard onto the platform



Respond to customer support tickets and questions



Follow up with prospects after demos and inquiries



Follow up with customers to make sure they're getting value from the platform



Identify customer issues and coordinate with our development team when technical assistance is needed



Keep customer information, opportunities, and follow-ups organized in our CRM



Document common questions and help improve our customer support processes



Help identify opportunities to convert interested prospects into paying customers



What We're Looking For



Strong spoken and written English



Comfortable speaking with customers on calls and video meetings



Friendly, professional, and patient communication style



Organized and reliable with good follow-up habits



Comfortable learning new software and explaining it to others



Previous experience in Customer Success, Customer Support, Account Management, or SaaS Sales is strongly preferred



Experience working for a SaaS or technology company is a big advantage



Nice to Have



Experience with Zoho CRM



Experience with Zoho Desk



SaaS customer onboarding experience



Experience conducting software demos



Sales or lead follow-up experience



Tagalog and/or Bisaya language skills



Working Hours



This position will work Philippine da
 hours.



Our customers are primarily located in the Philippines, so you will be communicating with Filipino businesses and customers throughout the day.



Who Would Be a Great Fit?



You may be a great fit if you've previously worked in customer support or sales and want to move into a broader Customer Success role.



We're especially interested in someone who doesn't simply wait for support tickets to arrive. We want someone who will proactively follow up with customers, make sure they're successful, and help turn interested prospects into long-term customers.

title: Customer Operations Dispatcher
description:
Dropcurb is a growing U.S. junk-removal marketplace. We are hiring a dispatcher to help coordinate customers, pickup providers, quotes, and active orders.



This is a fast-moving role, but being fast is not enough. We are looking for someone who is careful, responsible, customer-focused, and willing to verify information before making decisions.



Our biggest requirement is simple: do not guess.



If something does not look right, stop, check the information, ask questions, or escalate it.

Customer Operations Dispatcher



Remote - Philippines

Full-Time

U.S. Hours



Responsibilities:



Respond to customers and pickup providers



Handle and prioritize incoming quotes



Monitor active and upcoming orders



Review order details, photos, messages, and completion proof



Help verify that the correct items were picked up before approving completion



Request additional photos or information when something is unclear



Help resolve active pickup issues



Keep customers updated when there is a problem



Escalate unusual, high-risk, or unclear situations



Follow company procedures carefully



Maintain accurate notes and order information



Provide professional, natural English communication to U.S. customers



Customer experience is extremely important to us.



If Dropcurb makes a mistake, we do not blame the customer, the pickup provider, or another employee. We take ownership, apologize when appropriate, explain what we are doing to fix it, and make sure the customer is taken care of.



We are looking for someone who:



Has excellent written and spoken English



Pays close attention to detail



Cares about customers



Can work quickly without becoming careless



Is comfortable asking questions when unsure



Takes responsibility for mistakes



Does not become defensive when receiving feedback



Can prioritize several urgent tasks at once



Has good common sense and judgment



Can stay calm during busy periods



Learns from mistakes and does not repeat them



Is reliable and consistent



You are not a good fit if:



You regularly guess when information is unclear



You rush through important decisions



You blame other people when something goes wrong



You are careless with customer issues or money



You become defensive when corrected



You repeatedly make the same mistakes



You need constant supervision



You care more about closing a task than making sure it was handled correctly



Schedule:



Approximately 9 PM to 7 AM Philippines time, 6 days per week.



Exact schedule may vary depending on team coverage.



To apply, please send:



Your relevant work experience



Your current or most recent monthly compensation



Your expected monthly compensation



Your availability and earliest start date

title: Google Ads Media Buyer for Lead Gen/ECom
description:
We are a lean PPC agency serving eCommerce and lead-generation brands. We are hiring a part-time Google Ads media buyer, starting with a dental lead-generation account, with scope to grow after a successful trial.



We need someone who can identify what matters, recommend exact changes, explain the evidence and carry approved work through implementation and follow-up. Your work should make account decisions easier for our team.



What you will own

- Monitor spend, pacing, lead volume and available lead-quality signals. Flag material risks with a recommended next step.

- Analyze search terms, keywords, campaign structure, targeting, ads and conversion measurement in the context of the business.

- Submit a short prioritized change queue with current state, exact proposed change, supporting data, risks and review criteria.

- Implement approved changes, check the result and keep a clear change log.

- Connect with the team on tracking, landing pages and lead handling; identify dependencies you cannot resolve yourself.

- Write concise weekly updates covering results, uncertainty, actions and decisions needed.



What makes you a fit

- Hands-on Google Ads lead-generation experience, ideally with local service or dental accounts. Explain your personal contribution to the examples you share.

- Sound judgment with incomplete data. You can distinguish platform conversions from qualified leads and historical patterns from current evidence.

- Reliable estimates, clear communication and self-review. You flag missing information and scope increases before the deadline or hour cap.

- Practical AI use is welcome. You verify facts, settings and proposed changes and remain accountable for the final work.



How to apply

Please send: (1) one redacted lead-generation work sample showing a decision you made and its result;

(2) what you personally did and how results was measured;

(3) your rate, current workload, weekly capacity and exact overlap; (4) one example of an AI-generated recommendation you corrected and how you verified it.



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief reasoning screen, a short interview and a paid, limited-scope trial with one revision. The trial focuses on one campaign and a usable change request. No full account audit is required in your application.

title: E-commerce Product Lister & UGC Content Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Lister who can create and publish high-quality product pages for our ecommerce stores.



This role is not just about uploading products. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn a product into a convincing, trustworthy and conversion-focused product page.



An important part of the role is creating realistic UGC-style testimonials for every product we list. You must therefore already have experience generating realistic testimonial content and understand how to make it feel like it genuinely came from real customers.



Your responsibilities include:



- Listing new products in our ecommerce stores

- Writing and formatting product titles

- Creating conversion-focused product descriptions

- Selecting and organising the best product images

- Making sure product pages look professional and trustworthy

- Adding the correct pricing, variants, colours and sizes

- Checking the complete product page before publishing

- Following our SOPs and product listing structure exactly

- Making sure every product page is optimised for our target audience

- Creating realistic UGC testimonials for every listed product

- Generating testimonial images that feel authentic and customer-made

- Creating different UGC scenarios instead of repeating the same type of testimonial

- Checking generated images carefully for AI mistakes before using them



The UGC testimonial part is extremely important.



We do not want generic AI-looking testimonials.



You should understand how to create realistic scenarios such as:



- A customer taking a mirror selfie while wearing the product

- Someone unboxing their order at home

- A product casually photographed on a bed or sofa

- A customer showing the product to a friend

- A natural photo taken inside an ordinary home

- A close-up product photo that looks like it was taken quickly on a phone

- Different customers using different wording, expressions and styles



The testimonials should not all look or sound the same.



You need to pay attention to details such as:



- Natural lighting

- Realistic skin texture

- Realistic hands and fingers

- Correct product details

- Correct colours

- Realistic homes and backgrounds

- Natural phone-camera framing

- Different customer personalities

- Different writing styles

- Natural use of emojis where appropriate

- Avoiding repetitive testimonial structures

- Avoiding obvious AI artefacts



You must be able to look at generated content critically.



If an image contains incorrect buttons, wrong materials, strange hands, unrealistic proportions or details that do not match the original product, you should notice this yourself and regenerate it before publishing.



We are looking for someone who is:



- Extremely detail-oriented

- Experienced with ecommerce product listing

- Experienced with AI image generation

- Experienced with realistic UGC-style testimonial creation

- Comfortable working with Shopify

- Able to write strong product copy in English

- Able to follow SOPs accurately

- Proactive when a product page can be improved

- Able to work independently

- Able to spot mistakes before a product goes live

- Focused on conversion, not just completing tasks



Previous experience is required.



You must already have experience with:



- Product listing for ecommerce stores

- Shopify or a similar ecommerce platform

- Writing product descriptions

- Working with product images

- Generating AI images

- Creating realistic UGC-style content or testimonials



This is not a role for someone who only knows how to copy information from a supplier page and paste it into Shopify.



We are looking for someone who understands that every product page needs to sell the product, build trust and look credible to the customer.



When applying, please include:



- Your previous experience with product listing

- Which ecommerce platforms you have worked with

- Examples of product pages you have created

- Your experience with AI image generation

- Examples of realistic UGC or testimonial images you have created

- Which AI tools you currently use

- Your availability

- Your timezone



Please only apply if you already have experience creating ecommerce product listings and realistic UGC-style testimonial content.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

• Proactive time management — Run their calendars proactively the way they run their own — booked, protected, colour-coded, and always a step ahead.



Administrative & Operations Support

• Documents & agreements — Prepare and execute client agreements, build and customise proposals, and produce clean, professional documents, reports, and presentations.

• Systems & filing — Own and organise a large Google Drive database so records are structured and easy to find.

• Process execution — Follow documented SOPs to the letter and build your own systems where none exist — you'll be trusted to create order, not wait for it.

• RFP & portal management — Manage the process around RFP solicitations and government portals (managing the workflow, not answering them), keeping deadlines and submissions on track.

• General admin — Own the wide range of recurring and one-off admin that comes across the founders' desks so they can stay focused on high-value work.

Sales & Business Development Support

• Lead follow-up & CRM — Support business development with lead follow-up, prospect tracking, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date.

• Scheduling — Book and coordinate business development and prospect meetings.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive — ideally supporting more than one executive at a time

• Proven ability to manage demanding executive calendars and inboxes with discretion, structure, and good judgment

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft emails, documents, and correspondence on behalf of the founders daily

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

• Experience with broad, varied admin — documents, proposals, filing, process management — not just calendar and inbox

• Highly organised and self-disciplined — you keep everything in one system, not scattered across sticky notes, notebooks, and half-used lists

• A confident, self-managing operator who can switch gears between very different tasks without getting overwhelmed

• Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems early, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Comfortable working efficiently and being measured on output — you get the right work done in a reasonable amount of time

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Toronto business hours) long-term



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting two or more executives at once

• Experience with ClickUp or another project management tool (Asana, Monday, Trello)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Experience with proposals, RFPs, or agreement/contract administration

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first, automation-first workflow

• Background in staffing, recruiting, professional services, or consulting



Who Thrives in This Role

The founders have kept an EA in this role for years at a time when they've found the right person. Here's who that is:

• You lean into a learning curve instead of being intimidated by it — when something's new, your attitude is “I'll figure it out.”

• You thrive on variety and can switch between very different tasks in a single day without losing your footing

• You build your own systems and processes — you create order rather than wait to be handed it

• You're calm and low-drama under a full plate — you don't overthink or talk yourself out of things before you try them

• You're disciplined and organised — you manage your own time as tightly as the people you support manage theirs

• You work efficiently and take ownership — when something's in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarise, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly, and genuinely enjoy working smarter with AI and automation



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth

• Long-term, stable client placement with founders who invest in their people

• Clear KPIs, documented processes, and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching, training, and performance feedback

• Room to grow from executor into a broader ownership role over time

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please email the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your experience as an Executive Assistant

• Subject line: SFSS Executive Assistant – [Your Name]

Only candidates that follow the instructions above will be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

• Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

• Skills and communication assessment (30 min)

• Final client interview (30 min)

Photography & Media Support

• MLS Real Estate Videos: Create cinematic style horizontal property videos for real estate..

• Photobooth Display Videos: Design and update photobooth overlays and templates, as needed.

• Reels Editing: Create short-form video content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) using Premier Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.

• Long-form video editing: Interviews, podcasts, etc.

• AI Video Generation/Prompting: Use AI video generation tools to help bring creative and unique ideas to life to add to our video content.

• Assist with Writing and Maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Document processes and workflows to improve efficiency.

• Organization: Maintain organized records and files of images, projects, and updates in our system.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• We hire for attitude and train for skill, but experience in general administrative tasks is helpful

• Must be able to work flexible hours; Ability to work with a sense of urgency when focusing on a task

• Communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing; comfortably interface with clients

• Ability to maintain a positive rapport with co-workers, Realtors, and clients a must

• Carry out duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, codes and guidelines; Comply with all company policies and procedures

• Ability to perform repetitive tasks while maintaining speed of work and attention to detail without loss to production



Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of demonstrated experience with:

• Premier Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (Reels/Video Editing)

• Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics software

• Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)

• Must have a reliable computer capable of running the required applications and 4K60 video.

• Must have fast, reliable internet for remote collaboration.

• Good to excellent English skills (spoken & written) for communication, documentation, and team collaboration.

• Must be able to work 8am-Noon Monday-Saturday, Eastern Standard Time (4 hrs). There is potential for this to become a full-time job for the right candidate.



This is primarily a video editing role. Below are detailed descriptions of the skills required for this role.



--- Must-Have Skills (Absolute Needs) ---



Extreme File Organization & Project Archiving: Exceptional discipline in project folder structures, asset naming conventions, and systematic backup workflows. All raw footage, project files, assets, and final exports must be archived so any project can be re-opened instantly for client revisions.



Versatile Multi-Style Editing (Podcasts & Talking Heads): High versatility across formats—from fast-paced 9:16 short-form reels to multi-camera long-form podcast edits (multi-cam switching, speaker reframing, pacing, and audio balancing).



Multi-Project Daily Capacity & Rapid Execution: Proven ability to manage, prioritize, and deliver multiple video edits per day under tight real estate deadlines using proxy workflows, templates, keyboard shortcuts, and batch exporting.



Proactive Content Ideation & Simple Concepts: Ability to spot trending social media formats, identify viral hooks, and pitch simple, easy-to-execute content ideas that real estate agents can quickly film on camera.



Non-Linear Editing (NLE) Suite Mastery (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve): Expert proficiency in at least one professional desktop NLE—Adobe Premiere Pro, Apple Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve—with a clean, standardized timeline and bin structure.



Manual Color Correction & Grading: Strong technical ability to manually color correct and grade footage using vectorscopes, waveform monitors, and primary/secondary color controls (e.g., Lumetri Color, DaVinci Color Page) to deliver accurate skin tones and true-to-life interior colors without relying on automated filters.



Complex Motion Captions & Typography: Mastery in creating dynamic, animated, and highly legible text overlays (word-by-word highlights, callouts, brand fonts) designed to retain viewer attention on talking-head clips.

Social Export & Encoding Standards: Thorough knowledge of optimal platform export settings (H.264/HEVC, optimal bitrates, frame rates, color spaces) to ensure fast rendering and crystal-clear playback across all major platforms.



Speed Ramping, Motion Tracking & Masking: Advanced technical proficiency in speed ramping (smooth velocity curves for walkthroughs and transitions), motion tracking (attaching captions, callouts, or graphics to moving subjects), and masking (custom reveals, subject isolation, and targeted color adjustments).



Professional Sound Design & Multi-Track Audio Mixing: Expert ability to clean up low-quality audio, remove room echoes/reverb, balance multi-mic podcast setups, level agent vocals against background tracks, and layer subtle sound effects (swooshes, impacts, risers, ambient fills) to make videos feel polished and high-energy.



Advanced AI Prompting & Standout Creative Generation: Proven ability to craft highly specific, sophisticated text, image, and video prompts across generative AI platforms (e.g., video diffusion, generative fill, expansion tools) to create unique, high-end visual effects, cinematic property extensions, and signature styles that stand out from standard AI templates.



--- Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred Extras) ---



CapCut Desktop Proficiency: Ability to leverage CapCut Desktop for ultra-fast social edits, trending audio syncs, or rapid template builds when same-day turnaround is needed.



Motion Graphics (After Effects or Apple Motion): Experience creating or customizing lower thirds, animated property stats, transition overlays, or reusable graphics templates.



Real Estate Content Familiarity: Pre-existing understanding of property walkthrough flow, architectural framing, and real estate social media marketing trends.



All candidates offered an interview will need to perform a test edit and complete a color accuracy test.

title: Video Editor
description:
ABOUT US



We are a European e-commerce brand selling premium cookware (titanium pans). We run paid ads on
 and Instagram every day, and video is what makes or breaks our business. We are looking for one or two editors to become our go-to people for ad creative. Not someone who just cuts clips, but someone who can build a complete ad from scratch.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build full ad videos from scratch: hook, script, voice-over, visuals, captions, pacing, music

- Create the voice-overs for our ads. These must be in Norwegian and must sound like a natural, well-spoken native speaker. You generate these with AI voice tools. We do not want your own voice in our ads.

- Create new on-screen text and captions that actually sell, not just subtitle

- Generate new visuals and b-roll with AI tools when we do not have footage

- Produce VSL-style ads (longer, script-driven: problem, solution, offer)

- Research competitors and winning ads in the
 Ad Library and turn what you find into new angles for us

- Re-edit winning ads into new variations and new angles

- Deliver in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 where needed



REQUIREMENTS - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



- Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience editing video ads. Not wedding videos, not YouTube vlogs, but direct-response ads.

- Strong with VSL videos and VSL scripts. You understand hooks, retention, pacing and CTA structure.

- CapCut. You work in it daily and know it inside out.

- Higgsfield. Hands-on experience generating AI video and image assets.

- Claude. This is the AI we work with. You use Claude to write scripts, hooks and angles, and you know how to prompt it properly. Other AI tools do not replace this for us.

- Able to produce clean, natural-sounding Norwegian AI voice-overs. We do not use the editor's own voice.

-
 Ad Library. You actively use it to research what competitors are running, to spot winning ads and to pull inspiration from them.

- Real e-commerce understanding. You know how a product ad is supposed to look and feel, what a winning ad looks like, and why one video converts and another does not. We want you to send a red apple emoji with your application so we know you read the full post. Without it we skip the application.

- Good written English and reliable daily communication

- Stable internet and your own computer capable of editing



If you do not have all of the above, we are honestly not the right fit for you and we will not be able to move forward. We are hiring 1 to 2 strong editors, not five average ones.



PAY AND GROWTH



- $6 to $7 per hour to start, depending on your experience and the quality of your sample work

- Your rate goes up as your self-edited videos start performing

- Real bonuses when your ads win. If a video you made and edited yourself drives sales, you get paid for it. Good work is actually rewarded here, not just praised.

- Long-term position. We are building a small, fixed creative team of one or two editors, not rotating freelancers.



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a message here on OnlineJobs with:



1. The emoji described above in the requirements section

2. One edited video ad for a titanium pan. Your own edit, your own hook, your own on-screen text, and a Norwegian AI voice-over (not your own voice). Make it look like something we could run tomorrow. You can pull product footage and images from anywhere online, or generate them.

3. A short note: your experience, the tools you work in, and your available hours per week

4. Two or three examples of ad videos you edited before, with one line on the result if you know it



Applications without the sample titanium pan video will not be reviewed.

title: Administrative VA
description:
## Executive / Personal Virtual Assistant — Long-Term Opportunity



I am looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to help me manage a very busy professional life.



I work in the U.S. dental industry across several businesses, consulting/coaching projects, and dental practices. I have many things happening simultaneously, and I am looking for someone who can help me bring organization, structure, and follow-through to all of it.



This is NOT a position where I want to tell you every day what to do.



I am looking for someone who eventually learns how I work, sees what needs to happen, keeps track of the details, reminds me when necessary, and handles things without waiting for me to ask.



### What you may help me with



- Calendar and appointment management

- Scheduling and rescheduling meetings

- Keeping track of follow-ups and deadlines

- Organizing my daily and weekly priorities

-
 and administrative support

- Preparing and organizing documents

- Maintaining spreadsheets and lists

- Following up with clients, team members, and contacts

- Organizing files and information

- Helping coordinate several projects at the same time

- Basic research

- Data entry and administrative tasks

- Keeping track of things I mention so they don't disappear from my radar

- Learning and using AI tools to make our work faster and easier



Over time, I would like this person to become my right hand for administrative organization.



### You may be a great fit if you are:



- Exceptionally organized

- Proactive rather than reactive

- Comfortable working independently

- An excellent communicator in English

- Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture

- Comfortable reminding me and following up with me

- Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Good at figuring things out

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software

- Comfortable using AI/ChatGPT

- Reliable and consistent

- Someone who genuinely enjoys creating order out of a lot of moving pieces



Experience working with a U.S.-based executive, entrepreneur, consultant, coach, or business owner is a strong advantage.



Dental experience is helpful but NOT required.



### Most important



I don't need someone who simply completes a list of tasks.



I need someone who thinks.



If you see something that could be organized better, tell me.



If I'm about to forget something, remind me.



If something doesn't make sense, ask.



If you can solve something without me, solve it.



The goal is simple:



**Help me spend less time managing administration and more time doing the work that only I can do.**



### To apply



Please answer these questions:



1. Tell me about the busiest person you have supported. What did you manage for them?

title: Amazon FBA - Online Arbitrage / Wholesale Assistant
description:
Remote Amazon Sourcing & Operations Assistant

Remote | Part-Time or Full-Time | Some UK Hours Required



Who We Are

We run a growing UK Amazon seller business with a strong track record and an expanding product range, spanning Online Arbitrage (OA) and wholesale. Our sourcing is methodical and driven by data, and we're building a skilled, dependable remote team. If you're an experienced Amazon professional looking for a role with room to progress, we'd like to hear from you.



About the Role

You'll find profitable products to resell on Amazon, working to clear, firm sourcing criteria, and support the daily running of the business, from inventory and shipments to supplier follow-ups and customer queries. It's a role with real responsibility, suited to someone who takes ownership of their work and keeps their standards high.



What You'll Be Doing

  Sourcing and Listings

- Finding profitable OA and wholesale opportunities using Keepa, SellerAMP and other approved tools

- Reviewing sales rank history, pricing trends, Buy Box activity and competitor levels

- Checking ROI, estimated monthly sales and competition against our criteria

- Logging each lead in our internal tracker with full supporting data

- Reaching the daily lead target agreed with the team

- Adjusting prices on live products as needed

   Customer and Account Support

- Responding to customer
s

- Reviewing and claiming reimbursements

- Maintaining prep sheets

- Following up with suppliers on outstanding invoices

   Inventory and Shipments

- Keeping track of stock levels

- Setting up and creating shipments

   Team Communication

- Giving team leads clear, timely updates on findings and any issues

- Keeping on top of Amazon policy changes that affect sourcing



What You'll Need

- Proven hands-on experience with SellerAMP and Keepa

- Previous experience working with Amazon FBA and Seller Central

- A demonstrable record of sourcing profitable OA and/or wholesale products

- Solid understanding of Buy Box mechanics, and of how IP complaints and hazmat flags can rule out a lead

- Excellent written English for customer correspondence

- Strong organisational skills and confidence with Google Sheets or Excel

- Dependable internet and your own laptop or PC that runs browser extensions smoothly

- Ability to cover some UK working hours

Bonus skills: Tactical Arbitrage, BrickSeek or similar tools; knowledge of ungating and restricted categories; experience following SOPs within a VA team.



*Two-Week Probation*

Every new team member starts with a two-week probation period, during which we'll look at:

- How accurate and well-documented your leads are against our criteria

- Whether you consistently hit your daily output

- How clearly and promptly you communicate

- Your reliability and attention to detail

- Team leads will give you feedback along the way, and your place in the role is confirmed once you complete the probation successfully.



** Zero Tolerance Lead Policy! **

We operate a strict zero tolerance policy on lead integrity. Every lead you submit must be one you found yourself using approved methods. Using leads from shared lists, paid lead groups,
 groups or any third-party lead service is strictly forbidden and will result in immediate termination. We carry out verification checks, and any lead found on a publicly shared list will be flagged.



What You'll Get

- Competitive pay based on your experience and results (to be discussed at interview)

- A flexible, fully remote working arrangement

- Clear expectations and regular feedback

- Genuine opportunities to progress

- Bonuses linked to consistent, high-quality lead submissions

- A stable, long-term role within a professional team



The Person We're After

You have a solid background in Amazon sourcing and operations, and you're also a strong fit for how we work:

- Experienced: a proven track record with Amazon sourcing and operations

- Meticulous: in sourcing, small errors can be expensive

- Self-driven: you meet your daily targets without needing close supervision

- Honest and open in everything you do

- Dependable: you show up consistently, hit deadlines and communicate proactively

- Ambitious: you want to grow with the business



Please don't apply if you:

- Use, or plan to use, shared lead lists or lead groups

- Aren't willing to complete the two-week probation

- Can't commit to consistent daily output

- Aren't comfortable following strict sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Lack hands-on experience with Keepa and SellerAMP



How to Apply

To show you've read this far, add "Orange" to your application title. 

Then send us:

- A short introduction covering you and your background

- Your experience with Amazon FBA, Keepa and SellerAMP (how long you've used them, and whether you'd rate yourself intermediate or advanced)

- Your availability (hours per day, days per week, and the UK hours you can cover)

- Your expected pay rate or range

- An example of a sourcing decision you've made, with your reasoning

- Three leads you sourced in the past 7 days, each including the ASIN, source store/URL, buy cost, Amazon selling price, estimated ROI, and a Keepa screenshot or link (Only UK Amazon/Leads)

- A video of no more than 60 seconds telling us why you'd be a great fit for this role (a link is fine, for example Loom, Google Drive or an unlisted YouTube video, as long as we can view it without requesting access)



We can't review applications that are missing any of the above, and videos longer than 60 seconds may not be watched in full.



This is a remote position. Serious applicants only.



Many thanks for your time and we look forward to seeing your Applications!

title: Founding Retention & Email Lead — E-commerce
description:
Remote · Full-time · Worldwide · Strong performance upside



We’re a fast-growing international e-commerce company looking for an exceptional retention operator to build our entire retention engine from zero.



Today, we’re doing approximately $600k+/month in revenue and growing aggressively.



A few months ago, we were at ~$150k/month.



Then ~$300k.



Then ~$600k+.



We’re building toward $1M, $2M, $3M+/month and beyond.



But retention?



It’s basically untouched.



We have:



* 35,000+ existing
 profiles

* 6 Shopify stores

* Dozens of international markets

* Multiple product categories

* New products launching constantly

* Significant paid acquisition volume

* Klaviyo already in place

* Almost zero
 revenue today

* No active campaign engine

* Almost no live flows

* No serious
 capture system

* No SMS strategy

* No subscription engine

* No systematic replenishment

* No winback engine

* No real cross-sell system



In other words:



You won’t inherit a retention machine. You’ll build it.



Your mission



Build retention into a major profit center for the company.



 is the first mission.



But we’re not looking for someone whose ambition ends at sending campaigns and optimizing Klaviyo flows.



We want someone who thinks about the entire customer lifecycle:



How do we turn more first-time buyers into second-time buyers?



How do we increase customer LTV?



When should each customer hear from us?



What should we sell them next?



When should we replenish?



Which customers should receive which offer?



Where should we capture more
s?



Should we introduce subscriptions?



Where does SMS make sense?



How do we generate more incremental contribution profit from the customers we already paid to acquire?



That’s the job.



What you’ll own



You’ll have end-to-end ownership of retention, starting with:



*
 strategy

*
 copywriting

* Campaigns

* Lifecycle flows

* Segmentation

* Deliverability

* List growth and capture strategy

* Post-purchase

* Cross-sells

* Replenishment

* Winback

* Customer reactivation

* Product affinity

* Customer cohorts

* LTV analysis

* Retention offers

* Subscription strategy

* SMS where appropriate

* Retention analytics and attribution

* Testing and experimentation



You’ll also work closely with paid acquisition and CRO so retention isn’t treated as an isolated channel.



You can challenge offers, discounts, bundles, pricing presentation, subscriptions, gifts and other commercial decisions.



If you need design or technical resources, we’ll provide them.



If you’re capable of executing something yourself, even better.



We move extremely fast



This is important.



We’re not looking for someone who needs their first 30 days to perform an audit, create a strategy deck and prepare a roadmap.



You’ll obviously analyze the business.



But you’ll analyze while shipping.



If you join Monday, we expect meaningful retention infrastructure to start going live within days.



We have a strong bias toward action:



Launch → measure → learn → iterate → scale.



We’d rather run intelligent experiments and learn from real customers than spend weeks debating hypothetical optimizations.



Who we’re looking for



You are a hands-on retention operator.



You’ve personally built and scaled
/lifecycle systems for serious e-commerce businesses.



You’re an excellent direct-response copywriter.



You understand customer psychology, offers and merchandising—not just
 software.



You’re highly analytical.



You understand LTV, repeat purchase rate, cohort behavior, contribution margin and incrementality.



You understand deliverability deeply enough to own it.



You can work inside Klaviyo or similar platforms without relying on other people for basic execution.



You’re comfortable with Shopify.



You know how to build flows, segments, campaigns and automations yourself.



You understand how
 interacts with Meta, Google, CRO and the broader customer journey.



You experiment relentlessly.



You’re autonomous.



You move fast.



And when something breaks, your first instinct is to investigate and solve it—not wait for someone else.



Builder > Manager



We’re specifically looking for someone who enjoys zero-to-one environments.



If your strength is managing a large CRM team and delegating execution, this probably isn’t the right role today.



Initially, you’ll be hands-on.



You’ll write.



You’ll build.



You’ll launch.



You’ll analyze.



You’ll experiment.



You’ll figure things out.



But if you build the function successfully, we don’t expect you to remain a solo operator forever.



You’ll have the opportunity to hire people underneath you and grow into Head of Retention / Lifecycle across our brands.



Our environment



We’re a small, ambitious, highly autonomous team.



We’re fully remote.



We operate internationally across dozens of markets and languages.



We work primarily asynchronously.



We don’t believe in recurring meetings for the sake of meetings.



You’ll have direct access to the CEO and significant freedom to operate.



Our localization infrastructure allows us to adapt and deploy content across markets quickly.



We sell across several consumer categories, including health, supplements, pet and home products.



New products and markets are launched constantly.



Speed matters here.



Ownership matters more.



What success looks like



We’re starting from almost zero, so the initial opportunity is enormous.



Your first objective is to establish the retention fundamentals quickly and start generating meaningful incremental revenue and profit.



From there, we want you to systematically increase:



* Repeat purchase rate

* Customer LTV

* Incremental contribution profit

* Revenue per customer

* Cross-sell penetration

* List size and quality

* Replenishment

title: Graphic Designer
description:
ELLSEY Creative is looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our creative team, working across a diverse portfolio of brands, industries and creative projects.



We’re looking for a designer with strong creative judgement who can understand what needs to be communicated, who it needs to connect with, and develop the right creative response. Someone who can work within established brands while still bringing fresh thinking to the work, and who cares about the details that separate good design from great design.



This is a hands-on creative role for someone who can think independently, work confidently at pace, take ownership of their work, and consistently deliver to a high standard.





Role focus:



As a Graphic Designer at ELLSEY Creative, you’ll work across a broad range of client brands and design requirements, from everyday content through to campaigns, publications and larger creative projects. You won’t simply be implementing layouts or waiting for someone else to determine the creative direction. We expect our designers to think. 



You should be able to understand the content, audience and objective, determine how it should be communicated visually, and carry that thinking through to the finished work. You’ll need to move confidently between different brands and styles without allowing your own personal design style to dictate every outcome.





Key responsibilities:



Develop creative concepts and visual directions across client projects

Design high-quality digital and print assets across multiple brands

Create campaign creative, social media assets, EDM graphics, presentations, documents, publications, marketing collateral and other brand materials

Take supplied content and determine the strongest way to communicate it visually

Apply and extend established brand identities across different formats and applications

Translate complex or content-heavy information into clear, visually engaging design

Create strong layouts with considered hierarchy, typography, composition and use of imagery

Source, select and work with imagery and visual assets appropriate to each brand and project

Prepare artwork correctly for digital and print production

Maintain consistency and attention to detail across every deliverable

Manage multiple projects, brands and deadlines without compromising the quality of the work

Take ownership of design outcomes from initial concept through to final artwork





Design capability:



You are highly proficient across the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly:



InDesign

Illustrator

Photoshop



You have strong foundations in typography, layout, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and brand application.



You understand that strong design is not simply about making something look good. It needs to communicate clearly, support the objective and feel right for the brand and audience. You can work within an established brand system without becoming constrained by it. You know how to create variety, develop new ideas and keep creative fresh while maintaining the integrity of the brand.





How you think:



- You bring ideas to the table

- You can look at content, understand what it is trying to communicate and determine how it should come to life visually. You don’t need every creative decision made for you before you can begin.

- You notice when something feels off. You care about proportion, spacing, typography, hierarchy and the small details that affect the overall quality of a design.

- You are comfortable receiving feedback, but you also have enough experience and creative judgement to explain your decisions and contribute your own perspective.

- Most importantly, you understand that working across multiple client brands requires versatility. Great design for one client may be completely wrong for another.





Working at ELLSEY Creative:



ELLSEY Creative is a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll work across multiple clients, projects and priorities, often moving between very different brands and styles throughout the day.



You need to be comfortable working at pace. Priorities can shift, deadlines can be tight, and several projects may be moving at the same time. You can adapt quickly, stay organised and keep a clear head without allowing speed or pressure to compromise the standard of your work.



You’ll work with a high level of autonomy and ownership. We expect you to manage your workload, communicate early when something needs attention, meet deadlines and maintain our creative standards without needing constant direction.



We care about both quality and momentum. Great work matters, but so does being able to deliver it efficiently.





Highly regarded but not necessary:



Creative direction or senior-level design experience

Brand development and visual identity design

Website and digital design

UX/UI and an understanding of digital user experience

Motion graphics or animation, including After Effects

Video editing

Long-form documents, publications and information-heavy design





What matters:



This role suits someone who:

- Has strong creative instincts and excellent design fundamentals

- Produces work that feels considered rather than templated

- Can think conceptually as well as execute

- Works quickly and efficiently without sacrificing attention to detail

- Is comfortable managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines

- Remains focused and solutions-oriented when things get busy

- Can move quickly between very different brands and visual styles

- Takes ownership rather than waiting for constant direction

- Has exceptional attention to detail

- Cares deeply about the standard of the finished work



We’re looking for someone who wants to contribute creatively and take responsibility for the quality of what leaves the studio.





Remuneration:  



Pay rate is dependent on experience and demonstrated capability.





Applicants:



Please provide links to recent work. Please do not include work created with AI.

Please only apply via Online Jobs, those who
 directly outside the platform will not be considered.

title: Production Operations Manager - USA Construction / Home Services - Residential
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POSTING, IF YOU DON'T YOU WILL BE SCREENED OUT AUTOMATICALLY



We are an established residential home services company based in the Minneapolis–St. Paul area of the United States, and we are looking for an exceptional Production Operations Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day logistics behind our projects.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable making decisions, and capable of managing a constantly changing production schedule without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.



You will work remotely but will be responsible for coordinating U.S.-based subcontractor crews, customers, schedules, field staff, and production systems. This is a key operational role within the company, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the business.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Schedule projects and coordinate job starts

• Coordinate subcontractor crews and maintain an accurate production schedule

• Create, send, and manage work orders

• Recruit, screen, and onboard new subcontractors

• Maintain an active subcontractor roster and track availability

• Continuously build a strong pipeline of qualified subcontractors

• Make sure we have enough production capacity for upcoming work

• Monitor projects from scheduling through completion

• Solve day-to-day production and scheduling problems

• Communicate with subcontractors, customers, salespeople, and field staff

• Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

• Track project status, delays, issues, and completion

• Coordinate warranty work, punch-list items, and smaller service projects

• Coordinate with U.S.-based field staff and help ensure they are being utilized efficiently

• Coordinate quality-control visits and project inspections

• Follow up on outstanding production issues until they are fully resolved

• Build and improve systems and processes that make production easier to manage and scale



A major part of this role will be recruiting and managing our subcontractor network. We do not view recruiting as something that should only happen when we urgently need additional workers. The Production Operations Manager should continuously develop relationships with qualified subcontractors so we have enough capacity as production volume changes throughout the year.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with previous experience in operations, construction, home services, property management, logistics, dispatching, project coordination, or a similar environment.



The ideal candidate:



• Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Can manage many projects and moving pieces at the same time

• Is comfortable making decisions and solving problems independently

• Communicates extremely well in written and spoken English

• Is confident communicating with U.S. customers, contractors, and field workers

• Is comfortable holding people accountable

• Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them

• Can prioritize quickly when several issues happen at once

• Learns new software and systems quickly

• Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where schedules can change

• Has experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company

• Has experience coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other distributed workers

• Is looking for a long-term position with an opportunity to take on greater responsibility



We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between completing tasks and owning an outcome. You should be able to look at the entire production pipeline, determine what needs attention, communicate with the right people, and make sure things get done without requiring constant direction.



If we have projects starting next week, you should already be confirming subcontractor availability. If capacity is becoming tight, you should already be recruiting. If a customer or production issue develops, you should take ownership of getting it resolved. If the same type of problem keeps occurring, we want you to help improve the system so it stops happening.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, long-term position with a typical workload of approximately 40 hours per week. Some weeks may be lighter and others may require additional time depending on production volume and seasonality. Because you will be coordinating with U.S.-based customers, subcontractors, and field staff, you must be available primarily during U.S. Central Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday. This means working overnight hours in the Philippines, so please only apply if you are comfortable maintaining this schedule long term.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is $2,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience, ability, and fit. There is significant opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who performs well and becomes a key long-term member of the company.



TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Begin your application with the words "I AM YOUR NEXT PRODUCTION MANAGER" so we know you carefully read the entire posting.

2. Briefly describe your experience managing operations, projects, contractors, logistics, or schedules.

3. Describe a situation where something went wrong operationally and explain how you handled it.

4. Tell us about your experience working U.S. business hours or overnight shifts.

5. Tell us about any experience you have managing or coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other workers.

6. Include a short video introduction explaining your background and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to complete a practical operations exercise before moving forward in the hiring process.



We are looking for someone exceptional, dependable, proactive, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our company.

 • Bold/dramatic (Category A): "KRAKATOA IS AWAKE"  red hook text, mid eruption drama shot

 • Suspense (Category C): "2013 Oklahoma", "2011 Joplin" bold red year/place, ominous storm imagery

 • Restrained/respectful (Category B): "The Aberfan Disaster"  black and white tone, formal serif font, white text only, no red, no hype used only for tragedies with named victims



Core rules:

 • Every thumbnail must carry our consistent channel identity: same watermark placement, same signature design element (e.g. a consistent color grade or small recurring icon), same overall layout logic  regardless of topic

 • Within that identity, tone adjusts by category: Category A/C can be bold and red; Category B must stay restrained and respectful (see examples above)

 • One clear visual idea per thumbnail, with visible scale (small house/car/person next to the disaster) so danger reads instantly

 • Real photos by default  AI generated images never used for Category B

 • Max 2–4 words of text, max 2 colors  red only for Category A/C, never Category B

 • Must stay readable and "big and scary" even shrunk to mobile thumbnail size

You'll be doing:

 • Designing 1–2 thumbnail options per video based on the video's confirmed tone category, while keeping our consistent channel identity intact across every single one

 • Delivering source files (PSD or similar) for future edits



Requirements:

 • Portfolio showing bold, high contrast thumbnail design (disaster, true crime, or similar dramatic genres preferred)

 • Comfortable working from a detailed style guide and staying visually consistent across many thumbnails, even as topics change

 • Fast turnaround (24–48 hrs per thumbnail)

To apply, include:

 1. 3–5 thumbnail samples in a similar bold/dramatic style

 2. Your turnaround time per thumbnail

title: App Growth Marketer — Freelance / Part-Time
description:
App Growth Marketer — Freelance / Part-Time

SheepWorks · Remote · Flexible hours



About SheepWorks



SheepWorks Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore app studio focused on creating beautifully designed, highly functional and engaging digital experiences.



We believe good software should do more than simply work. It should feel intuitive, thoughtful and enjoyable to use. Our approach combines strong functionality with immersive design, playful interactions and a willingness to explore new ideas.



We build across everyday utilities, mental wellness, gamified experiences and other digital products where thoughtful design can make a meaningful difference.



Three values guide how we work:



- Integrity means building responsibly, being transparent in how we work, respecting user privacy and doing what we believe is right even when it is not the easiest option.

- Ownership means caring deeply about what we create, taking responsibility for outcomes and continuously improving the experiences we put into the world.

- Agility means staying curious, experimenting, learning quickly and adapting as technology, users and opportunities evolve.

- At SheepWorks, our goal is simple: create useful digital experiences that are thoughtfully made, beautifully designed and genuinely enjoyable to use.



Our direction



- Make it worth making. Start with a real need and create something useful. Every product, feature, and campaign should have a clear purpose.

- Strengthen the whole. Share ideas, learning, and capabilities so that good work in one part of SheepWorks helps the rest grow.

- Sweat the useful details. Care about the details that improve someone’s experience—from clear messaging to reliable delivery and thoughtful design.

- Earn the play. Build substance first, then bring creativity and humour. Our personality should make good work more memorable.

- Welcome people in. Be approachable, inclusive, and clear. High standards should make our products better for people and our team better to work with.



About the role



SheepWorks is looking for a hands-on freelance App Growth Marketer to help grow our mobile apps. You’ll work directly with the founder to plan, execute, and improve growth campaigns—from app discovery and installs to activation, retention, and paid conversion.



We’re looking for someone who can turn ideas into measurable experiments, work with a lean budget, and explain what’s working and what to try next.



What you’ll do



- Plan and execute growth. Develop a practical growth plan with clear priorities, budgets, and success metrics.

- Manage social publishing. Publish and schedule posts on relevant channels such as TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, including uploading and organising assets supplied by our designer or content creator.

- Write marketing copy. Create captions, hooks, ad copy, and campaign messaging tailored to each audience and channel.

- Run paid acquisition. Set up, manage, and optimise campaigns across relevant platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google App Campaigns, and Apple Search Ads.

- Test campaign performance. Test different audiences, creatives, messages, and budgets to identify what delivers meaningful results.

- Improve app store performance. Research and update ASO keywords and descriptions, brief visual improvements, and coordinate store-page tests.

- Lead growth experiments. Plan and coordinate tests involving landing pages, onboarding, pricing and paywalls, referral mechanics, and other growth opportunities, working with the founder, designer, and developer on implementation.

- Track the full user journey. Set up or review measurement with our developer and monitor performance from installs through activation, retention, and paid conversion.

- Make optimisation decisions. Recommend and execute decisions to stop, modify, or scale experiments within agreed budgets and approval boundaries.

- Report weekly. Provide a concise update on what was tested, what was spent, what worked, what didn’t, and what to do next.

- Explore additional growth channels. Identify relevant opportunities in organic growth, creator partnerships, and other acquisition channels.



What we’re looking for



- Strong Integrity, Ownership and Agility

- Demonstrated experience growing mobile apps, with examples of campaigns or experiments you personally managed.

- Hands-on experience with ASO and at least one major paid app acquisition channel.

- Understanding of app growth metrics such as cost per install, customer acquisition cost, activation, retention, lifetime value, and return on ad spend.

- Familiarity with tools such as Firebase, GA4, AppsFlyer, Adjust, App Store Connect, or Google Play Console.

- Ability to connect marketing performance to meaningful user and business outcomes.

- Strong written English, clear communication, and the ability to work independently.

- Comfort working with small budgets and prioritising the highest-impact opportunities.



You don’t need to be an expert in every channel. Tell us where you’re strongest and show us the results.



Engagement



- Freelance / part-time, fully remote.

- Flexible working hours, with agreed check-ins and deliverables.

- Initial paid engagement of 8 weeks, with potential to extend based on results and mutual agreement.

- Scope, hours, and compensation agreed based on experience and availability.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction and a summary of your mobile app growth experience.

2. One or two relevant case studies explaining your role, the channels used, approximate budget, timeframe, and results. Anonymised examples are welcome.

3. The growth channels and tools you’re most confident using.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected hourly or monthly rate.

5. A short answer: How would you approach your first 30 days growing an app with a limited budget?

title: Wedding Invitation Content Creator
description:
We are looking for a talented and creative person to create beautiful behind-the-scenes videos showing digital wedding invitation templates being put together on an iPad.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who has a strong eye for design, understands aesthetics, and enjoys creating satisfying, premium-looking social media content.



The style and quality of content we are looking for is similar to:




/snowstarstudioco/


/urweddingbestie_org/


/studiohouseofv/



Please look through these pages before applying so you fully understand the type of videos, filming style and overall aesthetic we are looking for.



The invitation templates are already designed and built.



You will be provided with the finished design and all of the elements required, including:



- Images

- Graphics

- Fonts

- Colours

- Text

- Decorative elements

- Final design reference



You do not need to research or create every design from scratch.



Your main job is to take the provided elements and recreate the finished invitation on your iPad while filming the process beautifully.



The videos may show things such as:



- Moving elements into position

- Adding typography

- Adjusting text

- Adding photos

- Changing or adjusting colours

- Resizing elements

- Adjusting spacing

- Using the Apple Pencil

- Building the design piece by piece

- Showing the completed invitation at the end



We want the process to feel natural, satisfying and beautiful to watch.



A good understanding of wedding invitations and design is a big advantage.



We would love someone who understands:



- Good colour combinations

- Typography and font pairing

- Layout and spacing

- Visual hierarchy

- Wedding aesthetics

- Modern invitation styles

- Luxury, editorial and minimal design

- What currently looks attractive on Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest



Although the finished designs will already be provided, we want someone with a good eye who can notice when something could look better and help with small design decisions where needed.



If you are also capable of creating new invitation templates in the future, that is a big bonus and may lead to additional work.



FILMING SETUP



The filming setup is extremely important.



Before we move forward with your application, we want you to show us EXACTLY how you would set everything up if you got this job.



Please do not just send a random photo of your desk or equipment.



Actually prepare the full filming scene exactly as if you were about to record one of our videos.



We want to see:



- Exactly where the iPad would be positioned

- The exact camera angle you would use

- Where your hands would be

- How you would use the Apple Pencil

- Your desk or table

- Your full background

- The lighting

- Any props or decorative objects you would include

- How everything would be positioned inside the final video frame



Everything visible in the video should be well placed and intentional.



We are looking for:



- A clean and aesthetic background

- Beautiful lighting

- Good camera quality

- A professional camera angle

- A clean desk

- Well-positioned objects

- Good composition

- A premium overall look



We want to see exactly what the final videos would look like if you were hired.



HOW TO APPLY



When applying, please prepare the actual setup you would use for the job and send:



1. A photo showing the complete filming setup from the exact camera angle you would use.

2. A short video filmed from that exact setup so we can see the camera quality, lighting, background and overall aesthetic.

3. Show your iPad and Apple Pencil in the setup so we can see how the actual filming would look.

4. Tell us which iPad you use.

5. Tell us which phone or camera you use.

6. Send examples of your design work.

7. Send examples of any aesthetic videos or social media content you have created before.



We care a lot about attention to detail, taste and overall presentation.



You do not need to have a huge portfolio. If your setup looks beautiful and you clearly have a strong eye for design, we are interested.



TEST TASK



If we like your setup and application, you will move to the next stage.



Message me and I will send you the actual invitation elements and finished reference design for the test.



You will then recreate the supplied invitation on your iPad and film a short sample showing the process.



You will not need to invent a new design.



Everything required for the test will be provided.



We will mainly be looking at:



- Your filming setup

- Lighting

- Camera quality

- Background

- Composition

- Attention to detail

- How naturally you use the iPad and Apple Pencil

- Accuracy of the recreated design

- Overall aesthetic

- How satisfying and premium the final video feels



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone we can work with long term.



If you are talented, reliable and consistently produce beautiful work, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time.



If you are also good at design, there may be additional opportunities to help create new invitation templates, improve existing designs and contribute your own creative ideas.



There is also an additional earning opportunity on top of the normal salary.



You will have the option to promote the product yourself through your own TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or other social media accounts.



You can earn commission for every sale you personally generate.



The more sales you generate, the more you can earn.



This means someone who becomes very good at creating this type of wedding content can potentially earn significantly more on top of their normal pay.



The affiliate side is optional, but there is a big opportunity for someone who understands wedding content, social media and what customers like.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, improve their skills and potentially become an important part of the creative side of the company.





PAY & EARNING OPPORTUNITY



This role includes a guaranteed base payment of A$400 per month, plus the opportunity to earn significantly more through sales commissions.
