title: Short-form Video Editor
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and

Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We film a lot of

short-form video ourselves and need an editor who turns that footage into videos people watch to the end.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You turn raw footage into Reels, TikToks and Shorts: a strong first two seconds, tight pacing, accurate captions

and light motion, in a consistent look per brand. One filming session of an hour should become 20 or more

clips. You work from the shoot guide and brief of our creative strategist, and our AI content creator supplies the

B-roll and visuals that were not filmed. Most of our videos are in Dutch; a Dutch colleague checks the captions

before anything is published. Your work is split across our bathroom brand (Sanitairstudio), the wider BKG

group and our tile brand (Tegelstudio), so you switch between brand looks.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Cut each filming session into 20 or more vertical clips, following the shoot guide: choose the moments, build

the hook, cut the dead air.

Edit for retention: the strongest moment first, tight pacing, and B-roll, zooms and on-screen text where they

help.

Add captions in our brand style, accurate and well timed. For Dutch videos you work with auto-transcription

and a glossary of our terms, and a Dutch colleague checks the captions before publishing.

Build and maintain the look per brand: caption template, title and lower-third animations, colors and export

presets.

Deliver versions: per platform (length, safe zones, cover frame) and ad variants with different hooks for our

Meta ads specialist.

Handle mixed footage: phone, pocket camera, 360° (reframing) and drone. Clean up the sound and match

the color.

Keep delivery reliable: an agreed delivery day per batch, clear file names, an organized archive and a B-roll

library. One round of feedback should be enough.



REQUIRED SKILLS

2+ years of short-form editing, with a portfolio you can link to.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 1 / 4

A professional editor of your own (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut) next to CapCut. CapCut or

Canva alone is not enough for this role.

Strong pacing and hooks: you know what the first two seconds must do, and you can explain your choices.

Captions that are accurate, readable and timed to the speaker, and a clear process for captions in a

language you don’t speak.

Motion basics: animated titles, callouts and reusable templates.

Fast with AI-assisted tools (auto-captions, auto-clipping), and you know when to fix things by hand.

Clean sound, and you know which music a business account is allowed to use.

A computer that handles 4K footage and an internet connection that handles large files.

Reliable and responsive on your working days. Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE

Tell us which ones you have worked with.

CapCut, Submagic and Opus Clip: we provide these.

Your own DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut. After Effects is a plus.

Insta360 Studio for reframing 360° footage.

Canva for cover frames.

A shared drive for footage; Bitrix24 for briefs and feedback.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience editing Dutch or other foreign-language video.

After Effects and motion templates.

Sound design and color grading.

Long-form YouTube or podcast editing.

Home, interior or real-estate content.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, 20 hours per week, spread over at least four days, with daily responsiveness on those days. We

agree on a delivery day for each batch of footage. You have a weekly check-in with our content team during

Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, highspeed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You turn footage around quickly without dropping quality: tight pacing, clean captions, an on-brand finish. You

follow the brief, you say so when footage is unusable, and you can tell us why you made a cut. If you spot a

way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$398/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “KEYFRAME” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these

four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Name two short-form videos you edited and give the two links. A link to a folder or a full portfolio does not

count. For each: what you received (raw footage, brief) and what you did yourself.

2. Pick one of the two. Name one specific choice you made, with the timestamp (a cut, a caption timing, a

motion element), and why. Then name one thing you would do differently today.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 2 / 4

3. Most of our videos are in Dutch and you don’t speak Dutch. How do you cut on meaning and get the

captions right? Give your steps, and say where a Dutch colleague comes in.

4. You receive one hour of raw footage from a single filming session, plus a shoot guide. We want 20 clips.

Describe your workflow and tools from download to delivery, and how many working hours you need.

Also include:

Your editing software and whether you have your own license, your computer (processor, RAM, graphics

card) and your internet speed.

Your usual turnaround for one 30 to 60 second short from raw footage, and which days and hours

(Philippine time) you are available.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: AI Content Creator
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and

Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We publish a lot of

short-form content and need someone who makes everything the camera did not capture.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You make the visuals that were not filmed: images, B-roll clips, backgrounds, carousels and infographics. You

start from what is real, our showroom photos, product photos and 3D bathroom designs, and you use AI to

animate, extend and complete it. We sell real products, so a generated image is never presented as a real

customer project or a real product. You work from the briefs of our creative strategist and deliver to our video

editor and our social team. Your work covers Sanitairstudio, Tegelstudio and the wider BKG group, with the

group as the biggest share.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Build a prompt library and visual templates per brand (look, light, colors, typography), so everything we

publish looks like one brand.

Make the visuals that were not filmed. Start from our own photos and 3D designs (animate, extend, upscale)

and generate the rest: backgrounds, cutaways and title cards.

Deliver B-roll clips and images to our video editor in the right format, on the agreed day.

Design carousels and infographics in Canva from the briefs of our creative strategist.

Draft the captions for those posts. Dutch text is drafted with AI and our templates, and a Dutch colleague

checks it before it goes out.

Repurpose: turn one idea into several formats, such as a carousel, an infographic, a pin, an article image or

an ad creative.

Check every asset before you deliver it (hands, taps, reflections, tile lines, text), and label AI-generated

content where platforms require it. Voice or avatar work is done only with the consent of the person shown.



REQUIRED SKILLS

1+ year making content with AI image and video tools, with a portfolio.

Image generation and editing beyond the prompt: reference images, inpainting, upscaling, and placing real

products into a scene.

Image-to-video: short B-roll clips made from stills that hold up on a phone screen.

BKG · Vacature 10 van 10 · AI Content Creator · 3 oktober 2026 1 / 4

Good visual taste. You can match a brand look, and your work does not look generic.

Canva: carousels and infographics from a brand kit, with clean typography.

A sharp eye for AI mistakes, and the patience to fix them.

You know the rules: platform labels for AI content, commercial-use rights of your tools, and never showing a

generated image as a real project or product.

You work from a brief, at pace, and you keep your files and prompts organized.

Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE

We provide Krea, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Canva and Claude. Tell us which of these you know, and which other

tools you use (for example Midjourney, Flux, Runway, Kling, Photoshop or Topaz).



NICE TO HAVE

Interior, architecture or product visuals.

Photoshop: generative fill and compositing.

Basic motion in CapCut or After Effects.

Ad creatives that were tested with budget.

Experience working with 3D renders.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, 22 hours per week, spread over at least four days. We agree on a delivery day for each batch. You

have a weekly check-in with our content team during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is

afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You fill the gaps the camera can’t: fast, on-brand and without hand-holding. You are honest about what is

generated: if a visual could be mistaken for a real project, you say so before it goes out. If you spot a way to

improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$438/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales. Long-term, stable role.

BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “INPAINT” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four

questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Share three pieces you made with AI tools for real content, with links: one image, one video clip (B-roll or

animation) and one carousel or infographic. For each: the tools you used, and what you fixed or changed by

hand after generating.

2. We sell real bathrooms and tiles, and we have real showroom photos and 3D designs. A script needs a shot

of a finished bathroom that we never filmed. What do you make, and what would you never present as real?

3. You need ten images and five short B-roll clips that look like one brand. How do you keep the look

consistent, and which AI mistakes do you check for before you deliver?

4. From one video and its brief you make a five-slide carousel with Dutch text, a language you don’t speak.

Describe your steps, and how you prevent text mistakes on the slides.

Also include:

Your usual turnaround for a five-slide carousel and for a five-second B-roll clip. Only share work that already

exists; please don’t make anything new for this.

Which tools you have your own subscription for, and which days and hours (Philippine time) you are

available.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Nox Sleep



We're a premium sleep-optimization brand for high performers — athletes, founders, and ambitious people who treat their recovery as seriously as their training. We're building our content engine and need a skilled video editor to turn raw footage and our existing graphic designs into polished short-form Reels for Instagram and TikTok. You'll be the person who makes our content look like a real brand: clean, premium, and scroll-stopping.



What you'll do



You'll edit 8–12 vertical Reels per month (with room to grow) from assets we provide — raw footage, product clips, B-roll, music, and a brief for each one. Specifically:



Cut and assemble footage and B-roll into finished vertical Reels (9:16), and adapt to 4:5 and 1:1 when needed

Pace edits to music — cut on the beat, build rhythm, and hook the viewer in the first 3 seconds

Add clean, on-brand burned-in captions (most people watch on mute)

Color grade to our brand look — deep midnight-blue, cinematic, premium, and consistent across every video

Add text overlays, titles, and simple motion graphics in our brand style

Animate our existing infographics — we have a library of designed static graphics (sleep-science data visualizations) that we need animated into Reels: numbers counting up, charts drawing themselves in, text appearing in sequence. This is a key part of the role.

Export correctly for each platform, properly compressed, no quality loss



What we're looking for



Proven experience editing short-form vertical content (Instagram Reels / TikTok) — please show examples in your application

Strong motion-graphics skills — you can animate text, numbers, charts, and simple data visualizations, not just cut clips. This is essential.

Fluent in a professional editor — Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut (desktop/Pro)

A real eye for pacing, hooks, captions, and clean typography — you understand what makes a Reel actually perform, not just how to use the software

Able to match a consistent brand color grade across many videos

Fast, reliable turnaround (24–48 hours per Reel) and clear communication

Good written English — enough to follow briefs and give/receive feedback

Self-directed — you can take a brief and raw assets and deliver without needing hand-holding on every cut



Nice to have



Experience with health, fitness, wellness, or e-commerce/DTC brands

Ability to find and suggest licensed music and sound effects

Basic product/photo editing and retouching



How to apply



Please include:



Your portfolio or showreel — with short-form vertical Reels specifically (and any infographic/motion-graphics work you've done)

The editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time per Reel

To confirm you read this: start your application with the word "NIGHT SHIFT" at the top



Strong candidates will be asked to complete one paid test edit using our assets before we hire — this is how we'll see your speed, taste, and how you follow a brief.

title: VA | Operations & Business Support Specialist
description:
About Culture One



Culture One is a Diversity, Inclusion, Neurodiversity and Wellbeing consultancy, working with organisations to create more inclusive, human-centred workplace cultures through training, consulting and partnership programmes. 



The business is founder-led and moving from its early solo-founder stage into active growth across client delivery, partnerships, learning and advisory services.



This role is being created to strengthen the operational backbone of the business and reduce the amount of day-to-day coordination and administration sitting with the founder.





The Role at a Glance

This is not an entry-level VA position.

We need an experienced and proactive operations and founder-support professional who is highly reliable, organised, and who takes ownership of the day-to-day running of their role end to end. Someone who improves how things get done, not just someone who executes a task list.



The role combines hands-on operational support with improving how recurring work is organised.





Why This Role Exists



Culture One is run by a single founder who is now splitting her time between delivery, sales, and a growing partnership pipeline. Admin and operations currently sit with her, and that no longer scales. We need someone trustworthy enough to take real ownership of that side of the business, so the founder's time goes back into value driven work. 





Hours & Working Structure



• Commitment: 20 hours per week, ongoing, part-time.

• Schedule: Ideally split across the working week (around 4 hours/day) rather than compressed into one or two full days – several responsibilities need same-day attention.

• Time zone: Fully remote. The role is largely asynchronous, but the person should be comfortable with some regular overlap with Irish working hours (typically 08:00–16:00 Irish time) for check-ins and time-sensitive items. Please tell us in your application what shift pattern you would propose.





Core Responsibilities



Inbox, Calendar and follow-up management

• Triage and organise the Culture One inbox.

• Identify priorities and required actions.

• Draft or progress routine correspondence within agreed parameters.

• Maintain follow-ups so
s and commitments are not lost.

• Manage calendar and scheduling administration.

• Surface founder decisions clearly when input is required.



Operational coordination and process improvement

• Maintain a reliable operating view of open, completed, blocked and upcoming work.

• Own recurring administrative processes without needing to be reminded each cycle.

• Create and maintain practical SOPs and checklists.

• Notice gaps, duplication or inefficient processes and recommend improvements.

• Anticipate recurring work and upcoming deadlines.

• Maintain the industry events and speaking-opportunity tracker, proactively researching and adding relevant items.

• Take on research and other defined operational projects as needed.



Digital organisation and Microsoft 365

• Keep SharePoint, Teams and business files structured, current and easy to navigate.

• Maintain consistent naming, filing and version-control practices.

• Help Culture One make better use of its Microsoft 365 environment.

• Maintain professional consistency across documents and presentations using Culture One templates.



Invoicing, bookkeeping and accounts administration

• Prepare and issue invoices, maintain accurate bookkeeping records, and follow up on overdue payments.

•  Keep accounts records accurate and up to date.



CRM and opportunity administration

• Keep CRM records accurate and current.

• Maintain next actions and follow-up dates for prospects, clients and partners.

• Identify overdue follow-ups and prepare the next step.

• Support light business-development and partnership administration, without responsibility for sales closing.



Content administration

• Maintain the content calendar and publishing workflow.

• Coordinate assets, scheduling and publishing.

• Keep content files and supporting materials organised.

• Make basic updates to the Culture One’s Squarespace website as needed.

• Manage uploads and basic admin on the video/LMS platform (e.g. subtitles, organisation).

• Flag missing information or assets before they create delays.





What We Are Looking For



Essential

• At least three years' relevant experience in operations, executive support or senior virtual support.

• Experience working directly with a founder, small-business owner or senior leader.

• Evidence of independently managing work rather than relying on daily task assignment.

• Exceptional organisation, reliability and follow-through.

• Strong attention to detail and quality control.

• Experience building or maintaining operating processes, trackers or SOPs.

• Confident use of Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Experience coordinating content or social-media administration.

• Comfortable working in a small, growing business where not every process is already built.



Strong advantage

• SharePoint organisation or administration.

• CRM management.

• Professional-services or consultancy experience.

• Experience using AI tools effectively within business workflows.





Tools & Systems



ALREADY COMFORTABLE WITH:

• Microsoft 365: Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint, used at a genuinely strong level. Someone who can organise and improve how we use the Microsoft 365 environment is a real plus.

• Canva: For design and content assets.

• Calendly: Managing discovery call bookings from the website.

• Squarespace: Our website platform – enough familiarity to make edits/updates and continue to upskill to maximise our website and hosting platform.



HAPPY TO TRAIN ON:

• Xero or Quickbooks: Our accounts platform, this is being newly set up. General bookkeeping/accounts software experience is a plus but not required.

• Video / LMS platform: We're moving off Vimeo onto a new video hosting or LMS-style platform for training content. This means learning to upload content, add subtitles, and handle basic admin.





We value people who:

• Value different working styles – we don't all work the same in the same way.

• Close loops – follow work through to completion and confirm when it is done.

• Notice when something has been missed.

• Bring a recommendation where possible, rather than simply presenting a problem.

• Ask good questions when judgement is genuinely required.

• Challenge inefficient ways of working constructively.

• Take responsibility for the quality of their work.

• Communicate early when something is blocked.

This is a strengths-based role. We value curiosity, problem-solving and a learning mindset, and we will support you to build new skills while making the most of the strengths you already bring.





Skills Profile

We're looking for genuine strength across most of the areas above, backed by real examples – not a generalist who is only lightly familiar with each. That said, if you are strong across the majority of this brief but have a gap in one or two specific areas, say so honestly in your application. We would rather hire a strong, self-aware operator and support their development in an area than hire someone who is learning across the board.



What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: Core systems and workflows are understood; inbox, invoicing, scheduling and routine admin are being run independently and reliably.

• First 60 days: Recurring work no longer needs to be assigned manually – open actions are visible, issues are flagged early, and practical process improvements are being proposed.

• First 90 days: Follow-ups are controlled, recurring processes run consistently, and the role is actively reducing operational dependency on the founder with minimal oversight needed on the basics.



Application & Selection Process

• 1. Application: CV/profile plus a short note on your operations and administration experience, and what shift pattern you could offer.

• 2. Interview: A competency-based interview about your experience and working style. 

• 3. Reference checks: We contact at least two previous clients or employers directly, with a focus on reliability and follow-through.

• 4. Offer: Start with a defined 30/60/90-day check-in plan (see 'What Success Looks Like' above).

title: Digital Marketing Ads Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Ads Specialist



Remote – Full Time | Philippines-based



AUD $2,200/month base salary



Lead-Gen & E-Commerce Campaigns | Meta Ads & Google Ads Required | Client-Facing Role



Most marketing jobs promise flexibility.

But still track every hour, fill your calendar with meetings, and micromanage every task.

That's not how we work.

At Maximize Marketing, we're building a small team of high-performing marketers who want freedom, ownership, and the ability to earn more based on the value they create.



This is a remote-first role where you're trusted to manage your clients, drive results, and grow your income based on the success you help create.



No time tracking. No micromanagement. No pointless internal meetings. Just great work, great clients, and real ownership.

Read This First: This Is a Client-Facing Role



This is not a back-office ads role. You will be the person our clients speak to,
 and message every week about their results, their budgets and their strategy.



That means two things are non-negotiable:

• Excellent, native-level English, both written and spoken. You will write client
s and reports, and join client calls. Your English must be clear, confident, professional and polished, with no exceptions.

• Strong client-facing skills. You can explain performance simply, handle concerns calmly, and make clients feel like they have someone truly in their corner.

If your English is not at the highest level, or you prefer to work behind the scenes without speaking to clients, this role is not for you.



The Lifestyle

Imagine a role where:

• You work remotely and structure your day around productivity, not clock-watching

• You earn a base salary of AUD $2,200/month + commission based on the clients you manage and retain

• Your income grows as your client portfolio grows

• You're trusted to manage your workload without someone breathing down your neck

• You build long-term client relationships and see the impact of your work

We believe great marketers thrive when they're trusted to perform.

The only thing we ask in return: be extremely responsive, organised, and on top of everything. If a client messages you, they shouldn't be waiting days for a reply.



Who This Role Is Perfect For

This role is ideal for someone who:

• Has 1+ year of experience working in a digital marketing agency

• Has hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Has exceptional English and is confident communicating directly with clients by
, message and video call

• Is self-motivated and highly organised

• Thrives in a remote environment where accountability matters



You're the kind of person who:

• Doesn't wait to be told what to do

• Notices opportunities before clients do

• Takes pride in delivering strong results

• Communicates clearly, professionally and consistently

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of client accounts and help drive results through:

• Managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Optimising campaigns for lead generation and e-commerce growth

• Communicating directly with clients on performance, strategy and next steps, through written updates and calls

• Identifying opportunities to improve results

• Helping clients scale through smarter marketing

You'll play a direct role in client success and retention, which is why this role includes performance-based earning potential.



How You'll Earn

Base Salary: AUD $2,200/month 



Why Join Maximize Marketing?

We're a growing agency built on one simple philosophy: great people should be trusted to do great work.

What that means for you:

• Remote-first work environment

• Flexible working structure

• AUD $2,200/month base salary

• Real influence in a growing agency

• No micromanagement culture



We care about results, ownership, and great client relationships, not how many hours you're online.



Requirements

• Native or near-native English, spoken and written (essential). You will be assessed on this during the application process.

• Excellent client communication skills. You are confident and professional with clients.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in a digital marketing agency

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

• Experience with lead generation or e-commerce campaigns

• Highly organised and self-driven

• Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

• Based in the Philippines

Bonus if you have experience with:

• Landing page optimisation

• CRO insights

• Briefing designers/developers



The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

Someone who:

• Wants freedom and responsibility

• Speaks and writes outstanding English and enjoys talking with clients

• Enjoys building long-term client relationships

• Is highly responsive and dependable

• Takes pride in delivering real results for clients

This role is not ideal for someone who needs constant supervision, prefers very structured corporate environments, or is not comfortable communicating directly with clients in English.

Application Process (Important)



To apply for this role, please include a short Loom video (2–4 minutes) answering the following questions. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Your Loom is also how we assess your spoken English and how you come across to clients, so speak naturally and confidently. Start with a quick intro (your name and where you're based), then answer:

- In your last role, what was your KPI, and what did you actually achieve against it?

- Talk us through a Meta campaign that was underperforming. What did you do to turn it around?

- When you look at a landing page, what are the top 3–4 changes you've made to increase conversion rates?

- In this role you'll be managing about 50 clients. Each might have around 20 tasks per week, plus new ones that come up. How do you organise your week so nothing gets missed?

- What's your process for maximising client satisfaction?



Your Loom video doesn't need to be perfect. We're simply looking for clear communication, honesty, excellent English, and someone who takes initiative.



Please include the Loom link in your application.



💡 Tip: Candidates who record their Loom in one take tend to stand out the most.

title: Video Editor Meta Ads (AI focus)
description:
***Who We Are***



Brida is a fast-growing eCommerce brand built by founders who scaled the company to seven figures per month within just two months. We are now building our creative team and looking for people who want to grow with us and help shape the next phase of this company.



We move fast, we produce at volume, and we reward people who take their craft seriously. Right now we run only static ads. Video is the next big unlock in our ad account and we need the right person to help us capture that opportunity immediately.

If you want to edit ads that are seen by millions of people, build something from scratch, and grow into a creative leadership role, this is your seat.



***The Purpose of This Role***



The purpose of the Video Editor at Brida is to take ad briefs from our creative team and bring them to life through the power of video editing and AI video generation.



As our Video Editor you are responsible for the actual execution and finishing touches on every video ad we produce. Our success as a marketing team will rely directly on your ability to comprehend each ad concept, strategically assemble the pieces, and enhance the overall marketing message through your edits.



You understand that the smallest details make the biggest differences. A single cut, a perfectly timed transition, the right text overlay in the right frame, these are the details that separate an ad shown to millions from one shown to very few.

But this role goes beyond traditional editing. You will also be responsible for producing AI-generated video content that pushes our creative output into entirely new formats, realistic UGC-style product videos, Pixar-style character animations, and AI science and explainer animations. This is not optional. It is the core of why we are hiring right now.



***What You Will Do***



Onboarding



- Analyze and absorb Brida brand guidelines, creative style, and visual standards before touching a single brief

- Review past winning and losing ads to calibrate your understanding of what works for our audience

- Explore and test AI video generation tools relevant to our ad formats



***Ongoing Responsibilities***



- Turn briefs into high-converting video ads

- Create AI video content (UGC-style, Pixar-style, explainer)

- Organize and deliver assets with proper structure

- Collaborate with Creative Director & Copywriters

- Apply feedback quickly and accurately

- Review ad performance weekly

- Stay current on eCommerce + AI video trends





***What We Are Looking For***



**Required Experience**



- 1–2 years editing ads for eCommerce/DTC

- Hands-on AI video creation experience (non-negotiable)

- Experience with UGC, Pixar-style, or explainer AI videos

- Proficient in 2+ tools (CapCut, Premiere, AE, DaVinci)

- Portfolio of actual ads (including AI work)

- Strong conversion-first mindset





**Strong to Have**



- Health/wellness or supplement experience

- Familiar with Meta metrics (CTR, hook rate, ROAS)

- Experience with Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Kling





**Character Traits We Hire For**



- Detail-oriented and creative

- Fast, reliable, and accountable

- Coachable and feedback-driven

- Strong communicator





***This Is NOT For You If***



- No AI video creation experience

- No eCommerce ad experience

- You prioritize aesthetics over performance

- You struggle with feedback or deadlines

- You want low accountability 





***Hours and Location***



1. Fully remote 

2. Work from anywhere in the world. 

3. Monday to Friday, flexible hours.

title: Clinical Support Coordinator (Remote, Philippines)
description:
About the role

We are a growing Australian mental health clinic network. We provide specialist treatment for people with depression, anxiety, chronic pain and PTSD, as well as structured mental health and brain health assessments. This role does the careful, structured work around each assessment and treatment course: gathering information, keeping patients on their follow-up schedule, and preparing files and drafts. That frees our Australian clinicians to spend their time on clinical judgement and sign-off. This is a trial role.



Role details

- Function: Supports the treatment delivery and patient follow-up stages of the patient journey, and our mental health and brain health assessments

- Reports to: CEO for now, and the Medical Director once appointed

- Clinical supervision: The Australian supervising clinician (GP, nurse practitioner or psychiatrist) for each patient. They make every clinical decision and sign off every report

- Works closely with: Patient Flow Lead, the in-clinic treatment team, and finance, billing and admin

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Engagement: Full-time contractor

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 3:00 pm Philippine time. Patients are in two time zones, an hour apart from October to April

- Probation: 3 months, reviewed against the KPIs below



Scope of practice in this role

Australian law requires anyone providing a health service to patients in Australia, including by telehealth, to be registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra). Unless you hold Ahpra registration, you will work in a clinical support role under Australian clinicians, and you will not practise as a nurse for our patients. In practice:

- You introduce yourself to patients as a clinical support coordinator working with the named Australian clinician, not as their nurse

- You follow structured templates and protocols. Clinical assessment, interpretation, diagnosis, treatment decisions and advice are made by the Australian clinician

- Every summary, letter and report you prepare is a draft until the Australian clinician reviews and signs it

- If you hold or gain Ahpra registration, the scope of this role will be reviewed with you



Key responsibilities



Mental health and brain health assessments

- Run the structured intake by video using the fixed template for each assessment type: mental health history and current symptoms, or brain health history, lifestyle and risk factors

- Send the self-report questionnaires, check they are complete and score them

- Book pathology where the assessment requires it, and chase results until the file is complete

- Prepare the assessment file and draft the patient summary and GP letter for the Australian clinician to review, edit and sign

- Cognitive testing is done by the Australian clinician unless the instrument's licence allows trained support staff to administer it



Treatment support and follow-up

- Pre-treatment calls: confirm forms, consent paperwork, arrangements and questionnaires are complete before the first treatment day

- Post-treatment follow-up on schedule: week-2 check-in calls, and preparing the week-6, month-4, month-6 and month-12 review appointments

- Monitor symptom questionnaires sent by SMS. Any result that crosses a threshold goes to the Australian clinician within one business day, and the same day for any risk item

- Follow up patients who miss two questionnaires in a row

- Prepare discharge paperwork and draft GP letters from the treatment record for clinician signature



Records and research data

- Keep every patient file complete and accurate in our practice software and other systems, on the same day

- Enter research data for consenting participants accurately, following the study protocol



What this role does not do

- Give clinical advice, make diagnoses, or d
 whether someone is suitable for treatment

- Interpret pathology, cognitive tests or questionnaire results for the patient

- Change treatment, medication or follow-up plans

- Handle billing or payments



Key performance indicators

- Assessment turnaround (headline): 5 business days or fewer from the patient's appointment to a report signed by the clinician. Your part is having the file and drafts ready within 2 business days. Reviewed weekly

- Follow-up on schedule: 95% or more of week-2 calls and booked reviews completed on time. Reviewed weekly

- Questionnaire alerts: 100% of threshold alerts passed to the clinician within 1 business day. Reviewed weekly

- Risk escalation: 100% of risk disclosures handed to an Australian clinician the same day. Reviewed every case

- Draft quality: 80% or more of drafts signed with only minor edits by month 3. Reviewed monthly

Targets are a starting point and will be reviewed with you as we learn what is realistic.



Safety and escalation

Some of our patients are very unwell. If a patient mentions self-harm, su
, or feeling unsafe, or scores above 0 on PHQ-9 item 9:

1. Stay with them, stay calm and listen.

2. Give them the Australian crisis contacts: 000 in an emergency, and Lifeline on 13 11 14.

3. Call the on-duty Australian clinician straight away, while the patient is still on the line if you can.

4. Record what happened in the patient file and flag it. Do not end your shift until the handover has been confirmed.



A typical week (Philippine time)

Each day starts by checking questionnaire alerts that came in overnight.

- Monday: Questionnaire alerts and weekend messages. Week-2 check-in calls. 15-minute huddle with the Patient Flow Lead at 8:00 am

- Tuesday: Two assessment intakes by video (mental health or brain health). Pathology booked where needed. Weekly numbers ready for the KPI review

- Wednesday: Assessment files prepared and drafts sent for sign-off. Pre-treatment calls for next week's patients

- Thursday: Two more assessment intakes. Follow-up on missed questionnaires. Review appointments prepared

- Friday: Discharge paperwork and GP letter drafts. Chase outstanding results. Records tidied and next week planned



Privacy and confidentiality

- You will handle Australian health information, which is protected under Australia's Privacy Act 1988. You will sign a confidentiality agreement and complete privacy training before you start

- Work only in our systems, in a private room where no one else can see or hear the patient. Do not save, download, photograph or forward patient information

- Research data is handled only as the approved study protocol allows



Your first 90 days

- Days 1 to 30: Trained on templates, questionnaires, systems and the safety procedure. Observe assessments and follow-up calls, then run them with review

- Days 31 to 60: Running follow-up calls and questionnaire monitoring independently. Preparing assessment files and drafts

- Days 61 to 90: Meeting the turnaround and follow-up targets each week. Drafts mostly signed with minor edits. Probation review



Essential

- A healthcare background, such as nursing, psychology or allied health

- At least 2 years working directly with patients, ideally in mental health

- Experience speaking with patients by video or phone

- Excellent spoken and written English, including clear clinical writing

- Reliable high-speed internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection and backup power, a quiet private room, a headset and webcam, and your own computer



Highly valued

- Nursing experience, especially in mental health or psychiatric care. A current Philippine PRC licence is a strong advantage



Desirable

- Experience working with Australian, US or UK patients

- Experience with standardised assessment tools or cognitive screening

- Experience with practice software or electronic medical records



How to apply

Please send the following to 
 address] by [day, date, time Philippine time]:

- Your CV, and your PRC licence number if you hold one

- A 60 to 90 second voice recording. Imagine a patient has just told you on a video call that they have been feeling hopeless for weeks. Tell us what you would say and do

- A short written summary (no more than 150 words) of a mental health patient you have cared for or supported, with no identifying details

- Your internet speed test result, your monthly rate, and when you could start



Use the subject line "Clinical Support Coordinator, [your name]". Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a short practical task.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Cold Calling & Follow-Up
description:
Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Inbound & Outbound Lead Follow-Up

Xpert Realty Group is looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Real Estate Lead Manager / Inside Sales Assistant (ISA) to manage incoming real estate leads, conduct outbound prospecting, consistently follow up with prospects, and schedule qualified appointments for our broker and agents.

This is not a general administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us make sure no legitimate real estate opportunity falls through the cracks.

You will work primarily inside Lofty CRM and serve as the first point of contact for many new buyer and seller leads.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor Lofty during your assigned work hours for new inbound leads

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and

- Call and follow up with older leads already in our database

- Make outbound prospecting calls to potential sellers

- Work buyer and seller internet leads

- Contact expired listings, FSBOs, absentee owners, distressed-property prospects, cash-offer leads, and other seller opportunities

- Qualify leads by determining their motivation, timeline, property situation, and real estate needs

- Schedule qualified appointments for the broker or assigned agent

- Immediately escalate hot or time-sensitive opportunities

- Follow our scripts and processes while still sounding natural and conversational

- Professionally handle common objections

- Accurately document every meaningful conversation in Lofty

- Update lead status, tags, notes, follow-up dates, and tasks

- Place leads into the appropriate follow-up or nurture process

- Continue nurturing prospects who are not ready today but may buy or sell later

- Help maintain a clean, organized CRM database

- Attend training, coaching, and roleplay sessions

- Track daily activity and weekly results

Inbound Lead Responsibilities

Speed-to-lead is important to this position.

When a new lead enters Lofty during your assigned working hours, you will be expected to quickly begin the appropriate contact process.

This may include:

Call → Text →
 → Qualify → Document → Schedule or Nurture

You should be comfortable communicating with people who have recently requested information as well as prospects who may require multiple follow-up attempts before responding.

Outbound Lead Responsibilities

You will also proactively contact prospects who have not recently requested information.

These may include:

- Older CRM leads

- Expired listings

- FSBOs

- Absentee owners

- Tired landlords

- Pre-foreclosure/distressed-property leads

- Cash-offer prospects

- Homeowners identified through prospecting lists

You must be comfortable making outbound calls and hearing “no” without becoming discouraged.

What We Are Looking For

You should be:

- Reliable

- Persistent

- Organized

- Coachable

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

- Confident on the telephone

- Professional and friendly

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with repetitive follow-up

- Able to work independently

- Able to follow a defined process

- Comfortable being measured by results

Strong spoken and written English is required.

You do not need an American accent, but homeowners must be able to clearly and comfortably understand you.

CRM Discipline Is Extremely Important

Every lead interaction should result in accurate CRM documentation.

We expect meaningful notes—not simply:

“Called lead.”

A good CRM note should explain what happened and what should happen next.

For example:

“Seller may relocate in approximately 3 months. Home needs some repairs. Interested in learning retail value and may consider a cash offer. Follow up Nov. 15.”

Technical Requirements

You must have:

- Reliable computer

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- Stable high-speed internet

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Webcam

- Quiet professional workspace

- Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

Preferred Experience

Previous experience with real estate, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, inside sales, or customer service is strongly preferred.

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- Lofty / Chime

- Follow Up Boss

- kvCORE

- GoHighLevel

- BoomTown

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Real estate investing

- Real estate wholesaling

- Seller lead generation

- Buyer internet leads

- Expired listings

- FSBO prospecting

- Cash-offer campaigns

Lofty experience is preferred but not required. We can train the right candidate.

Schedule

Part-Time – 20 hours per week

Approximately:

4 hours per day / 5 days per week

You must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

There may be an opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance.

Compensation

$5 USD per hour + performance-based bonus opportunities

Long-term growth opportunities are available for a candidate who consistently performs well.

How Performance Will Be Measured

We care about more than simply how many hours you work.

Performance may include:

- Calls made

- Leads contacted

- Meaningful conversations

- Speed-to-lead

- Follow-up completion

- Qualified leads generated

- Appointments scheduled

- Appointments held

- CRM accuracy

- Lead-to-client conversion

Our initial goal is approximately 4 qualified appointments per week, although expectations may be adjusted based on lead volume, list quality, and campaign type.

How to Apply

Please include all of the following:

1. Briefly describe your previous calling, sales, ISA, or lead-generation experience.

2. Tell us whether you have previously worked with a real estate agent, brokerage, investor, wholesaler, mortgage company, or property management company.

3. List the CRMs and dialers you have used.

4. Tell us your current internet speed and your backup internet plan.

5. Provide a link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound real estate leads.

6. Tell us your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.

7. Tell us whether you currently work for any other clients and approximately how many hours per week.

IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words:

FOLLOW-UP MATTERS

This lets us know that you read the complete job posting and can follow instructions.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team, not simply completing short-term tasks.

The right person will eventually become an important part of our lead-management system—responding to new opportunities, nurturing existing leads, identifying motivated prospects, and making sure the right opportunities reach our broker and agents at the right time.

title: Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager
description:
# Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager



**Company:** Opulent Credit  

**Position:** Remote Credit Repair Specialist  

**Experience Level:** Experienced — NOT Entry Level  

**Employment:** Part-Time to Start, With Opportunity to Grow  

**Industry:** Credit Repair / Consumer Credit / Financial Services



## ABOUT OPULENT CREDIT



Opulent Credit is a growing U.S.-based credit restoration and financial services company.



We are looking for an experienced, **RESULTS-DRIVEN Credit Repair Specialist** who can take ownership of the backend credit repair process and help us deliver an organized, professional, results-focused experience for every client.



This is NOT simply a data-entry or letter-generation position.



We need someone who understands credit reports, dispute processing, client file management, documentation, follow-up cycles, and progress tracking — and who can manage client accounts with minimal supervision.



## RESULTS MATTER HERE



We are specifically looking for a **results-driven specialist**.



Our clients hire us because they want meaningful improvement in their credit profiles. When inaccurate, incomplete, unverifiable, duplicate, outdated, or otherwise legitimately disputable negative information is reporting, we expect our specialist to pursue the appropriate correction or deletion diligently and professionally.



**We do not guarantee deletions.**



We do not expect you to dispute accurate information without a legitimate basis, fabricate claims, misuse identity-theft procedures, or promise outcomes that cannot legally or ethically be guaranteed.



However, when a client is **rightfully owed a correction or deletion**, we expect you to know how to identify the issue, build the appropriate dispute strategy, provide supporting documentation when available, follow up correctly, evaluate the response, and continue pursuing legitimate remedies when warranted.



Simply sending a dispute and waiting is **not enough**.



We want someone who asks:



- Why did this item remain?

- Was the dispute sufficiently specific?

- What documentation supports the client's position?

- What exactly did the bureau or furnisher investigate?

- Did the information change?

- Is the reporting now accurate and complete?

- Is an additional legitimate dispute warranted?

- Should the matter be escalated through another appropriate channel?

- What is the strongest compliant next step for this client?



You should be **persistent without being reckless**.



We want measurable results — including legitimate deletions, corrections, updated account information, removal of inaccurate personal information, resolution of reporting errors, and documented improvement across client files.



## YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is to keep every Opulent Credit client moving forward.



You should know:



- What stage every client is currently in

- What has already been disputed

- What changed on each bureau

- What was deleted, corrected, verified, or remains unresolved

- When the next action is due

- What strategy should be used next

- What documents or information are still needed

- Which cases require management attention



No client should ever sit untouched because their file was forgotten.



## CREDIT REPORT ANALYSIS



You will review and analyze consumer credit reports from:



- Experian

- Equifax

- TransUnion



You must be able to identify potentially:



- Inaccurate information

- Incomplete information

- Duplicate reporting

- Incorrect balances

- Incorrect account statuses

- Incorrect payment histories

- Incorrect dates

- Incorrect personal information

- Mixed-file information

- Unauthorized or questionable inquiries

- Collections

- Charge-offs

- Late payments

- Repossessions

- Bankruptcies

- Other potentially disputable reporting issues



You must understand the difference between legitimately disputable information and accurate information that should not be misrepresented as inaccurate.



## DISPUTE PROCESSING



You will be responsible for managing dispute cycles from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing each client's complete credit profile

- Developing an appropriate dispute strategy based on the client's actual report

- Preparing accurate and individualized disputes

- Processing bureau disputes

- Preparing appropriate furnisher/creditor disputes when applicable

- Managing personal-information disputes

- Uploading supporting documentation

- Maintaining copies of correspondence

- Tracking dispute submission dates

- Tracking expected response dates

- Reviewing bureau and furnisher responses

- Determining appropriate next steps

- Preparing subsequent dispute rounds when warranted

- Preventing unnecessary duplicate or repetitive disputes

- Escalating unusual or complicated cases to management



We do NOT want someone blindly generating the same dispute letter for every client.



Every client file must be reviewed individually.



## KNOWLEDGE EXPECTATIONS



You should have practical working knowledge of credit reporting and consumer protection requirements, including:



- Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)

- Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

- FACTA

- Consumer reporting agency dispute procedures

- Furnisher dispute procedures

- Reasonable investigation requirements

- Reinvestigation procedures

- Maximum possible accuracy principles

- Identity theft procedures

- Debt validation concepts

- Credit reporting timelines

- Deletion/reinsertion procedures

- CFPB complaint procedures

- Metro 2 reporting concepts



You do NOT need to be an attorney.



However, you must understand how these laws and standards affect legitimate credit reporting disputes and know when something should be escalated rather than making unsupported legal claims.



## CLIENT FILE MANAGEMENT



Organization is extremely important.



Every client file should contain clear documentation showing:



- Current credit profile

- Original negative items

- Current negative items

- Dispute history

- Dispute dates

- Dispute rounds

- Letters/documents submitted

- Bureau responses

- Creditor/furnisher responses

- Items deleted

- Items corrected

- Items verified

- Items remaining

- New negative items

- Score changes when available

- Required client documents

- Next recommended action

- Next follow-up date



Someone should be able to open a client's account and immediately understand exactly what has happened with that client.



## CLIENT PROGRESS REPORTING



This is one of the MOST IMPORTANT parts of this position.



Management must have visibility into the entire client base.



You will provide regular progress reports showing each client's status.



Reports should include:



**Client Name**  

**Current Dispute Round**  

**Date Last Action Was Taken**  

**Bureaus Worked**  

**Items Challenged**  

**Items Deleted/Corrected**  

**Items Remaining**  

**Score Changes, If Available**  

**Responses Received**  

**Current Status**  

**Next Recommended Action**  

**Next Action Date**  

**Documents Needed From Client**  

**Issues / Escalations / Notes**



We expect proactive reporting.



Management should NOT have to repeatedly ask:



"What's going on with this client?"



You should already know.



## WEEKLY OPERATIONS REPORT



You will also provide management with a weekly overview containing:



- Total active clients

- Clients currently in active dispute cycles

- New clients onboarded

- Disputes completed that week

- Bureau/furnisher responses received

- Total deletions/corrections recorded

- Clients awaiting responses

- Clients requiring another dispute round

- Clients waiting on documentation

- Stalled or problematic accounts

- Accounts requiring management attention

- Upcoming deadlines/actions



Accuracy is more important than making numbers look impressive.



## CLIENT ONBOARDING & QUALITY CONTROL



For new clients, you may be responsible for:



- Reviewing onboarding information

- Verifying required documents are present

- Confirming credit monitoring/report access

- Organizing client documentation

- Completing an initial credit audit

- Recording baseline credit information

- Identifying initial dispute opportunities

- Creating the initial case strategy

- Flagging missing or conflicting information before processing



Before anything is submitted, you are expected to perform quality control.



Names, addresses, account numbers, bureaus, dates, documents, and dispute reasons must be checked for accuracy.



## SOFTWARE



Experience with credit repair platforms is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- DisputeFox

- Credit Repair Cloud

- Dispute Panda

- Client Dispute Manager

- GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms

- Credit monitoring/report platforms

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Google Drive

- Project-management systems



If you have experience with DisputeFox specifically, please mention it prominently in your application.



## DATA SECURITY & CONFIDENTIALITY



You will work with sensitive consumer information.



You must:



- Maintain strict confidentiality

- Follow company security procedures

- Never download or share client information unnecessarily

- Never use client information outside authorized company systems

- Protect passwords and account credentials

- Immediately report suspected security issues

- Follow company policies regarding access to client data



Discretion and trustworthiness are mandatory.



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Results-driven**

- Extremely organized

- Detail-oriented

- Persistent

- Resourceful

- Reliable

- Proactive

- Analytical

- Consistent

- Deadline-driven

- Comfortable managing multiple client files

- Able to work independently

- Able to communicate problems before they become emergencies



We are not measuring performance solely by the number of letters sent.



We care about **case progression, legitimate deletions and corrections, accuracy, proper follow-up, documentation quality, turnaround time, and keeping clients moving toward the strongest credit profile legitimately available to them.**



You should be capable of managing a growing client caseload without allowing quality to decline.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



- 2+ years of hands-on credit repair/dispute processing experience preferred

- Experience analyzing all three major credit bureaus

- Experience managing multiple client dispute cycles

- Experience reviewing bureau responses

- Experience tracking deletions, corrections, and account changes

- Strong understanding of FCRA/FDCPA and credit reporting procedures

- Excellent written English

- Excellent organizational skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable computer and internet connection



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We prefer someone who can enter the company and contribute quickly rather than requiring extensive training on basic credit repair.



## BONUS EXPERIENCE



Strong candidates may also have experience with:



- CFPB complaints

- Furnisher disputes

- Identity theft documentation

- Secondary consumer reporting agencies

- LexisNexis

- Innovis

- SageStream

- CoreLogic

- Advanced credit report auditing

- Funding-readiness credit analysis

- Business credit

- Credit optimization



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful Credit Repair Specialist at Opulent Credit makes our backend run smoothly.



Client files are organized.



Disputes go out on schedule.



Responses are reviewed promptly.



Results are documented.



**Legitimate opportunities for deletions and corrections are pursued thoroughly.**



When the first attempt does not resolve a legitimate reporting issue, the specialist analyzes why and determines the appropriate next step rather than simply giving up.



Next actions are already planned.



Management always knows where clients stand.



Clients don't fall through the cracks.



And as our client base grows, our operational quality grows with it.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV

2. Number of years working specifically in credit repair

3. Credit repair software you have used

4. Approximate number of client files you have managed simultaneously

5. A description of your normal dispute workflow from onboarding through subsequent rounds

6. A sample of how you track/report client progress

7. Examples of legitimate deletions/corrections you have achieved, with ALL consumer personal information removed/redacted

8. Your experience with FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2 concepts, CFPB complaints, and furnisher disputes

9. Your expected hourly/monthly compensation

10. Your weekly availability



**IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST:**



At the very top of your application, write:



**OPULENT STANDARD**



Then answer this scenario:



*A client's first dispute round has returned. Two accounts were deleted, one account was corrected, three accounts were verified with no changes, and one bureau has not yet responded.*



Briefly explain:



- What you would document

- What you would report to management

- What you would review before determining the next action

- How you would approach the three verified accounts

- How you would make sure this client does not fall through the cracks



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for a **long-term, results-driven team member** who wants to grow with the company — not someone looking to complete the bare minimum.

KEYWORD → WEBSITE → ON-PAGE SEO → CONTENT → AUTHORITY → RANKINGS → TRAFFIC → LEADS



IMPORTANT



This is an execution role.



We are not looking for someone who will simply send us an SEO audit and tell us what another person should do.



You will actually be building, optimizing, improving and ranking websites.



What we need is someone who knows how to turn that into rankings and traffic.



TOOLS / EXPERIENCE

Experience with building sites on WordPress and/or Claude code, codex etc.



Experience with local SEO and lead generation sites



Long-term opportunity for the right person as we scale the number of websites.



TO APPLY



Send us a message telling us about your experience with local SEO and lead-generation websites.

About the role

The monthly package



Each month there are two topics. Here's everything you deliver in a month:



Topic 1

Topic 2

• 1 Instagram carousel (up to 5 slides, with caption) on the same topic, pointing people to the blog



Flexible Instagram content

• 2 more Instagram carousels (up to 5 slides each, with captions), which may follow the month's topics or cover something different

• Some months, these 2 carousels may be swapped for 4 single-image posts instead



Newsletter

• 1 newsletter (300-400 words) summarising both topics and linking back to each blog



Monthly total: 2 blogs, 4 carousels (or 2 carousels and 4 single posts) and 1 newsletter. Each piece includes relevant images; more on imagery below.



Because each blog and its carousel come from one topic, you only need to research it once. The skill we're looking for is keeping one voice consistent across every format, while adapting the wording naturally to each.



Topics are interiors-related and will be provided, and you're welcome to suggest your own.



Pay

• Paid within 3 days of final approval, via Wise or PayPal.

• Over time, if all is going well, there is potential for the package and the retainer to grow together.



Imagery



Sourcing beautiful, on-brand images is a big part of this role.



• Use Canva's library or reputable free stock sites, and list the source for each image.

• Never use Google Images, Pinterest or other designers' work.

• Brand or supplier images are used only with our approval, and we'll arrange the permission.



SEO



Each blog needs basic SEO: a meta title and description, a clear heading structure, image alt text and internal links. We provide a target keyword for each topic and a full brief once you're selected.



What you'll deliver



• Carousels and single posts: designed in your own Canva Pro account and exported as upload-ready image files, with captions supplied in a Google Doc.

• Blogs and newsletter: text in a Google Doc, ready to copy and paste, with headings and SEO details clearly marked. Blog images are sent as separate files.



Your own work



We're hiring you for your writing and eye, so all work should be yours: not copied or reworded from someone else's article, and not done by anyone else. Research facts and information as needed, but the writing and design should be your own. AI is fine for research and for checking spelling and grammar, just not for writing or rewriting the content.

• Canva Pro (required once hired)

• Fluent written English

• A good eye for composition and a sophisticated, classy aesthetic

• Knowledge of mid-range to high-end interiors, and comfort researching for the New Zealand market

• A basic understanding of SEO writing

• Experience creating AI-generated imagery is a plus

Friendly, approachable, professional, like a relaxed design columnist.



Timeline and revisions



• Monthly work is due within 2 weeks of the brief. We'll send feedback within 5 days, and revisions are due within one week of feedback.

• Each piece includes one round of revisions. Corrections for factual errors or missed brief points are always included, and anything larger is discussed first.

• New Zealand is about 5 hours ahead of the Philippines, so please allow for this.



How to apply



Please include "Content Writer 26" in your subject line for our records, then send:



1.  Samples of your work. For example, an Instagram post or carousel, a blog on interiors, design or lifestyle, or a short video. A file, a link or a Google Drive link is fine.

2.  A trial piece. Write one blog of 300-500 words and design its matching Instagram carousel of up to 5 slides, on an interiors topic of your choice.

   ◦ Send the blog as a Google Doc and the carousel as exported images.

   ◦ Free Canva and free stock imagery are fine for the trial. List the source for each image.

   ◦ If you're hired, you'll be paid for this trial (US$18), and it counts toward your first month.

3.  A few lines about your content experience.



Applications without samples and a trial piece won't be considered.



The selection process



1.  Application: we review your samples and trial piece.

2.  Short video call: shortlisted applicants are invited to a short 10-15 minute call.

3.  Hire: we start with the monthly package. The first two months are a settling-in period, with a quick check-in at the end to make sure it's working well for both of us. From there, the work grows as it develops.



We look forward to seeing your work!

We run a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling smartphone integration modules (wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) for BMW, Mercedes and Audi. We sell across the US, UK and Europe and run 5-figure monthly ad spend on Meta. The founder runs every campaign personally - you start as his right hand on the account, and the role grows from there.

You start as a helper on the account: daily monitoring, uploading creatives, building ad sets to our specs, keeping tracking healthy. Show results and you grow into running the monitoring fully, with your own test campaigns and budget.

title: Virtual Producer & Content Pipeline Manager ($800 - $1,000 USD/mo)
description:
FULL-TIME: 

Salary: $800 - $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience) + Performance increases. Hours: Full-Time (40 hours/week)



The Role:

I am a Real Estate Division Director in Singapore. I have a fully equipped studio, the industry expertise, and all the AI tools. What I do not have is the desire to sit alone in an empty room trying to project energy into a dead camera lens.



I am looking for a full-time Virtual Producer and showrunner. This is not a passive Video Editor or standard Virtual Assistant role. I need an assertive, intelligent pipeline manager who will tell me where to sit, what we are talking about today, and hold me accountable to producing content.



Who You Are:

You are a sparring partner, not an order-taker. If you need to be told exactly what to do every step of the way, you will fail here. I need someone sharp enough to hold a conversation and push back when needed.

You know how to "manage up." You are not intimidated by a busy boss. If I am making excuses or missing deadlines, you are comfortable calling me out and getting us back on track.

You are a systems thinker. You know how to take one piece of core content and turn it into ten pieces of micro-content using AI.



What You Will Do:

The Prep (Research): You will use AI to scrape competitor content and trends, extract what works, and build simple ad-lib outlines for me (Hook, 3 Main Points, Data/Evidence, Call to Action). No word-for-word teleprompter scripts. You must be smart enough to know when AI output is generic garbage and refine it into a sharp angle.



The Shoot (Directing): 

This is the most important part. You will be on Zoom/Riverside with me live while I shoot. You will ask me the questions, direct the flow, and give me a real human to talk to so the energy stays high.



The Multiplication (Post-Production): 

After the shoot, you own the distribution matrix. You will use AI tools to chop the video into clips, write LinkedIn posts, draft
 newsletters, and format captions for my final approval.



The Onboarding (The "Taste Transfer"):

We won't guess what works. For the first month, we will have a daily Zoom call where we review competitor videos together. I will tell you exactly what I love and what I hate until my "taste" becomes your taste.

title: iPad Wedding Invitation Content Creator / Designer
description:
We are looking for a talented and creative person to create beautiful behind-the-scenes videos showing digital wedding invitation templates being put together on an iPad.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who has a strong eye for design, understands aesthetics, and enjoys creating satisfying, premium-looking social media content.



The style and quality of content we are looking for is similar to:











Please look through these pages before applying so you fully understand the type of videos, filming style and overall aesthetic we are looking for.



The invitation templates are already designed and built.



You will be provided with the finished design and all of the elements required, including:



- Images

- Graphics

- Fonts

- Colours

- Text

- Decorative elements

- Final design reference



You do not need to research or create every design from scratch.



Your main job is to take the provided elements and recreate the finished invitation on your iPad while filming the process beautifully.



The videos may show things such as:



- Moving elements into position

- Adding typography

- Adjusting text

- Adding photos

- Changing or adjusting colours

- Resizing elements

- Adjusting spacing

- Using the Apple Pencil

- Building the design piece by piece

- Showing the completed invitation at the end



We want the process to feel natural, satisfying and beautiful to watch.



A good understanding of wedding invitations and design is a big advantage.



We would love someone who understands:



- Good colour combinations

- Typography and font pairing

- Layout and spacing

- Visual hierarchy

- Wedding aesthetics

- Modern invitation styles

- Luxury, editorial and minimal design

- What currently looks attractive on Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest



Although the finished designs will already be provided, we want someone with a good eye who can notice when something could look better and help with small design decisions where needed.



If you are also capable of creating new invitation templates in the future, that is a big bonus and may lead to additional work.



FILMING SETUP



The filming setup is extremely important.



Before we move forward with your application, we want you to show us EXACTLY how you would set everything up if you got this job.



Please do not just send a random photo of your desk or equipment.



Actually prepare the full filming scene exactly as if you were about to record one of our videos.



We want to see:



- Exactly where the iPad would be positioned

- The exact camera angle you would use

- Where your hands would be

- How you would use the Apple Pencil

- Your desk or table

- Your full background

- The lighting

- Any props or decorative objects you would include

- How everything would be positioned inside the final video frame



Everything visible in the video should be well placed and intentional.



We are looking for:



- A clean and aesthetic background

- Beautiful lighting

- Good camera quality

- A professional camera angle

- A clean desk

- Well-positioned objects

- Good composition

- A premium overall look



We want to see exactly what the final videos would look like if you were hired.



HOW TO APPLY



When applying, please prepare the actual setup you would use for the job and send:



1. A photo showing the complete filming setup from the exact camera angle you would use.

2. A short video filmed from that exact setup so we can see the camera quality, lighting, background and overall aesthetic.

3. Show your iPad and Apple Pencil in the setup so we can see how the actual filming would look.

4. Tell us which iPad you use.

5. Tell us which phone or camera you use.

6. Send examples of your design work.

7. Send examples of any aesthetic videos or social media content you have created before.



We care a lot about attention to detail, taste and overall presentation.



You do not need to have a huge portfolio. If your setup looks beautiful and you clearly have a strong eye for design, we are interested.



TEST TASK



If we like your setup and application, you will move to the next stage.



Message me and I will send you the actual invitation elements and finished reference design for the test.



You will then recreate the supplied invitation on your iPad and film a short sample showing the process.



You will not need to invent a new design.



Everything required for the test will be provided.



We will mainly be looking at:



- Your filming setup

- Lighting

- Camera quality

- Background

- Composition

- Attention to detail

- How naturally you use the iPad and Apple Pencil

- Accuracy of the recreated design

- Overall aesthetic

- How satisfying and premium the final video feels



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone we can work with long term.



If you are talented, reliable and consistently produce beautiful work, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time.



If you are also good at design, there may be additional opportunities to help create new invitation templates, improve existing designs and contribute your own creative ideas.



There is also an additional earning opportunity on top of the normal salary.



You will have the option to promote the product yourself through your own TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or other social media accounts.



You can earn commission for every sale you personally generate.



The more sales you generate, the more you can earn.



This means someone who becomes very good at creating this type of wedding content can potentially earn significantly more on top of their normal pay.



The affiliate side is optional, but there is a big opportunity for someone who understands wedding content, social media and what customers like.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, improve their skills and potentially become an important part of the creative side of the company.





PAY & EARNING OPPORTUNITY



This role includes a guaranteed base payment of A$200 per month, plus the opportunity to earn significantly more through sales commissions.

The base payment covers the regular invitation content we provide for you to recreate and film.



On top of this, you can earn commission for every customer you personally bring to the business.



If you enjoy TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or creating wedding content, you can also market the product yourself using your own content.



You will have your own tracking link/code so the sales you generate can be tracked.



The more sales you generate, the more you earn.



There is no fixed limit on the commission side.



We are especially interested in finding someone who sees this as more than just a small monthly job.



If you are good at creating beautiful wedding content, understand what brides like, and learn how to generate views and sales, there is an opportunity to build a much larger monthly income alongside the guaranteed base payment.



You will already have access to the designs, invitation content and product to create content around, so you do not need to build something from nothing.



If you are also talented at designing wedding invitations, there may be additional paid opportunities in the future to help create new templates and ideas.



We want someone who can grow with the business and benefit as the business grows.
