title: Sales Team lead
description:
Senior BDR / Campaign Lead / Sales Lead

Hands-on outbound sales and core team management responsibilities



URGENT HIRING  Immediate or short-notice availability strongly preferred

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours

We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need an experienced business development professional who can build a repeatable outbound pipeline while managing and improving a small sales team. You will personally prospect and nurture opportunities, coach junior colleagues, and take responsibility for campaign execution and quality. Team management is a core requirement. The initial priority is Qore’s own growth, with responsibility for outsourced client campaigns as agreed.

Reports to the Managing Director. Leads and develops the sales-development team and works closely with marketing.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities

Build and develop sales pipelines

• Define target customer profiles, research accounts and decision-makers, and build accurate, prioritised prospect lists.

• Run outbound activity through cold calling, personalised
 and LinkedIn. Qualify needs, business fit, buying process and realistic timing; progress prospects to an appropriate next step.

• Build nurture sequences for prospects who are not ready to buy. Maintain clear next actions, ownership and follow-up dates so viable opportunities are not lost.

• Create and improve CRM stages, qualification criteria, handoff standards and pipeline reports. Review ageing opportunities, conversion rates and forecast assumptions.



Manage and develop the team

• Set clear campaign priorities and individual responsibilities. Manage the day-to-day delivery of junior BDRs and appointment setters alongside your own agreed sales activity.

• Onboard and train colleagues, run call reviews and role-plays, provide specific feedback, and document coaching actions and progress.

• Identify performance gaps early, agree improvement actions and escalate persistent issues to the Managing Director. Build usable playbooks, scripts and quality standards.



Lead campaigns and coordinate delivery

• Translate a brief into an outbound plan covering audience, messaging, channels, sequencing, workload and reporting. Test changes and explain what the evidence shows.

• Coordinate with marketing on messaging, content, lead quality and campaign feedback. Keep Qore and client campaign data, promises and priorities clearly separated.

• Provide concise progress reports and explain risks, blockers and recommended improvements. Support prospect handover and client campaign reviews where required.

• Use prospect data responsibly, respect opt-outs and follow approved outreach and security requirements. Pricing, contracts and final commercial commitments remain with the Managing Director.



Required skills and experience

• At least three years of relevant B2B outbound sales or business development experience, including at least one year managing or directly coaching a small sales-development team.

• Evidence of personally generating qualified meetings and opportunities, with clear reporting periods and an explanation of your contribution versus the team’s results.

• Demonstrated ability to build a pipeline from research through prospecting, qualification, nurturing and sales handover.

• Confident cold calling, objection handling and consultative questioning, plus excellent personalised outreach writing.

• Practical experience with a CRM such as Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce, and prospect research, sequencing and reporting tools.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must be able to coach colleagues, lead client conversations and write clear professional messages with minimal editing.

• A hands-on leadership style, sound judgement, reliable follow-through and the ability to prioritise in an early-stage business.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, including agreed prime calling and outreach periods.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced sales provider, lead-generation agency, BPO, MSP or other company delivering services for multiple clients.

• Experience selling B2B professional services, marketing, IT, managed services or SaaS into UK or Australian markets.

• Experience establishing sales processes or improving an underperforming campaign in a small or growing business.



What success looks like

Success means a well-managed team, accurate pipeline visibility, consistent follow-up and a growing flow of held, qualified meetings and accepted opportunities. We will agree targets based on campaign maturity, audience and resources. Meeting quality, conversion and coaching outcomes matter alongside activity levels.



Availability and contractor terms

Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a brief explanation of why this hands-on leadership role suits you.

• One recent campaign example: service sold, target market, channels, timeframe, personal results and team results. Include meetings held, qualified opportunities or revenue where you can substantiate them.

• The number of people you managed or coached and one specific example of improved performance.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD, included weekly hours and any separately proposed incentive terms.



The selection process may include an interview, a short outbound role-play and discussion of a pipeline or team-coaching plan. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.



We are hiring urgently and reviewing applications as they arrive. Please make your availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.

Sheil Law Firm, a Denver, Colorado law firm, is hiring one senior legal assistant/paralegal to work directly with the attorney.



The firm is one attorney and this seat. There is no layer of management and nowhere for work to hide. When clients trust the firm, it will often be because of something you did.



Most clients come to us on one of the hardest days of their lives: a death in the family, a child in trouble at school, or another life-changing event. They will not remember the legal work. They will remember whether someone answered, whether it was right, and whether it was done on time.



Because of that, two things matter more than anything on your résumé:



Responsiveness

When a client or the attorney contacts you during your shift, you acknowledge it promptly, even if the answer is simply:



"Received. Working on it. I'll have an update by 3."



Silence is the fastest way to fail here.



Ownership

You take tasks to completion without being chased. If you hit a roadblock, you raise it immediately. If a deadline is at risk, the attorney hears it from you first.



“I was waiting to hear back" is not a status update. Following up is part of the job.



Beyond those two principles, the standard is simple: clients feel taken care of, work is accurate, and records stay current. If it isn't in the system, it didn't happen.



We hire for temperament as much as skill. If you need every task assigned, prioritized, and explained before you begin, this role is probably not a fit.



What You Get Back



We are building this firm and want someone who wants to build it with us.



Your work will be visible and meaningful. In return, you get an attorney who backs you, pays on time, values initiative, and rewards contribution. We are looking for someone who wants a seat they can grow into and keep for years.



Practice Areas



The paralegal will primarily support matters involving:



- Estate planning (wills, trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives)

- Probate and estate administration

- Guardianships and conservatorships

- Guardian ad Litem representation

- Juvenile, family, and paternity matters

- Education and special-needs advocacy

- Elder law and adult-protection matters



The firm may also handle selected matters in other practice areas, including personal injury, civil litigation, administrative proceedings, and related legal matters. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new processes and supporting work across multiple practice areas as the firm's needs evolve.



Responsibilities



Documents

- Prepare estate planning documents from attorney notes and firm templates

- Draft court filings, GAL reports, correspondence, and other legal documents for attorney review

- Proofread and redline documents for accuracy and consistency

- Assemble signing packages and coordinate witness/notary logistics



Client Management

- Respond to client communications the same day

- Conduct intake calls and gather missing information

- Keep clients informed about the status of their matter

- Escalate issues requiring attorney judgment



Records and Systems

- Maintain complete and current client files across firm systems

- Create and update matters, contacts, and client records

- Save and organize documents using firm naming conventions

- Perform conflict checks

- File and organize matter-related
s



Court and Matter Preparation

- Calendar hearings, deadlines, reviews, and signings

- Prepare hearing files and summaries

- Organize records, exhibits, and case history

- Research and summarize materials as assigned



Billing and Reporting

- Enter time and expenses

- Assist with monthly billing

- Provide regular status updates on active matters



Other Responsibilities

• Support firm operations, marketing, social media, technology, and special projects as needed

• Help improve systems, processes, and client experience

• Perform other duties reasonably related to the operation and growth of the firm



You May Be a Strong Fit If



- You notice details others miss

- You can manage dozens of active files without losing track of deadlines

- You learn processes quickly and retain them

- The attorney can assign you a task and stop thinking about it

- Your first drafts need editing, not rewriting

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You stay calm under pressure and own mistakes quickly

- You are looking for a long-term position, not your next position



Requirements



- 3+ years of legal assistant or paralegal experience, **or** a Bachelor of Laws/JD and membership in good standing with the Philippine Bar

- College degree

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage deadlines and files with minimal supervision



Only applicants meeting all requirements will be considered.



Preferred



- Experience in estate planning, probate, family law, juvenile law, personal injury, or litigation support

- Experience with HubSpot, ClickUp, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or legal practice-management software

- Comfort using AI tools for drafting, organization, and research



Schedule and Equipment



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time.  In Manila that is 10pm–7am (11pm–8am from November to mid-March). We are stating that plainly up front rather than discovering a mismatch in month two. The schedule is fixed, and this has to be your only job.

- This must be your only job

- Work is performed on a firm computer via remote desktop

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Backup power source

- Quiet private workspace

- Webcam, headset, and dual-monitor setup



Compensation



- $6.00-$8.00 USD per hour to start, depending on experience, qualifications, and interview performance

- Paid biweekly

- Compensation reviews at 6 and 12 months

- Paid US holidays

- Paid time off after probation



We are more interested in finding the right person than the cheapest person. Exceptional candidates may start at the upper end of the range.



Confidentiality



You will handle sensitive information, including estate planning documents, financial records, and information involving minors.



All work is performed under the supervision of a licensed US attorney on firm systems. A confidentiality agreement is required. This position does not involve providing legal advice.



How to Apply



 with the subject line:



**SENIOR LEGAL — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. Your résumé

2. Confirmation that you can work 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time and that this will be your only job

3. Your available start date and compensation expectations

4. Answers to the three questions below in your own words

5. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you



Questions



a. A client
s asking for a status update on her case. You check the file, the CRM, and the
 history. Nothing has been recorded in three weeks, and the attorney is in court all day. What do you do, and what do you write back to her?



b. You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



c. You open a new client's file to draft her trust and find no folder in Drive, no matter in the case system, and an intake sheet with two different dates of birth. Nobody has assigned you anything. What do you do?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid skills assessment before a final interview. We reply to every finalist.

title: Part-time Video Editor and Social Media Content Manager
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



We are Golden Vista Construction, a residential renovation company based in British Columbia, Canada. We specialize in kitchen, bathroom and condo renovations, and we are looking for a creative, reliable person to help us turn our raw video footage into professional social media content.



What we're looking for



We want someone who can take raw video footage and turn it into finished content with minimal direction.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Editing occasional longer YouTube videos

- Creating strong hooks that grab attention in the first few seconds

- Adding captions, text overlays, transitions, B-roll and graphics

- Creating thumbnails and cover images

- Writing or improving social media captions and video descriptions

- Repurposing one piece of footage into content for multiple platforms

- Scheduling and publishing approved content

- Helping identify good content opportunities from the footage we provide

- Eventually helping us plan content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule



Our goal



We are not looking to simply post more content.



Quality is more important to us than quantity.



Initially, our target is approximately 4–5 polished pieces of content per week.



The owner will batch-record renovation videos and provide raw footage. Your job is to take that footage and turn it into professional, educational and engaging content.



Our content focuses on topics such as:



- Kitchen renovations

- Bathroom renovations

- Condo renovations

- Basement renovations

- Renovation costs

- Before-and-after transformations

- Common renovation mistakes

- DIY advice

- Product and material comparisons

- Frequently asked homeowner questions

- Behind-the-scenes construction

- Lessons learned on real projects



Who we're looking for



You should have:



- Strong video-editing skills

- Experience creating Reels, Shorts or TikTok-style videos

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

- The ability to create attention-grabbing hooks

- Basic graphic-design and thumbnail skills

- Good written English

- Good communication and reliability

- The ability to work independently

- Attention to detail



Experience with construction, home improvement, real estate, interior design or contractor content would be a major advantage, but it is not required.



You must be willing to learn our industry and our brand.



Editing style



Our content should feel:



Professional. Educational. Authentic. Clean.



We do not want excessive effects or editing that makes the videos feel gimmicky.



Our goal is to establish Golden Vista Construction as a trusted renovation expert while creating content that homeowners actually find useful.



Compensation



Starting budget: up to C$500 per month, depending on experience, ability and expected hours.



This will initially be a part-time position.



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term working relationship, with the potential for the role and compensation to grow as our content program grows.



Paid Editing Test



We will shortlist approximately three candidates.



Each shortlisted candidate will receive:



- The same raw Golden Vista Construction video footage

- The same instructions

- The same deadline

- The same paid test fee



We want to see how you approach the footage creatively rather than simply judging you from your résumé.



We will evaluate:



1. The opening hook

2. Storytelling and pacing

3. Editing quality

4. Captions, graphics and visual presentation

5. Understanding of the message

6. Creativity

7. How much direction you require



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your location and time zone

3. Your expected monthly compensation for this position

4. Approximately how many hours per week you can provide within that budget

5. Links to 3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited

6. One example of a longer YouTube video, if available

7. The editing software you normally use

8. Any experience you have with construction, renovation, home improvement, real estate or similar industries



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you 20 minutes of raw footage from a kitchen renovation, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of social media content?



At the beginning of your application, write the words:



GOLDEN STANDARDS

STRESS-FREE RENOVATIONS



This lets us know you read the entire job posting rather than sending a generic application.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing Specialist

Content creation social media SEO fundamentals and campaign delivery



URGENT HIRING

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours / flexible

We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need a capable marketing practitioner who can turn a brief into clear content, consistent social activity and measurable campaign delivery. You will support Qore’s own marketing and agreed client work, adapting content to different brands and audiences. This role suits someone who can write well, produce practical creative assets, maintain basic website content and work closely with sales.

Works with the Marketing Manager, Managing Director and sales team.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities



Create useful and persuasive content

• Plan and write website copy, landing pages, articles,
 campaigns, social posts, case studies and sales-support content suited to the audience and objective.

• Research topics and interview colleagues or clients to extract useful insights. Check facts, edit carefully and maintain the agreed brand voice.

• Create and adapt graphics, presentations and short-form video using tools such as Canva, Adobe applications or equivalent. Keep a consistent visual standard.

• Manage a content calendar from brief and draft through approval, publication and repurposing. Organise assets and use appropriate permissions and licences.



Manage social media and campaign execution

• Plan, schedule and publish platform-appropriate content, particularly for B2B LinkedIn activity and other channels relevant to each brief.

• Monitor comments, messages and engagement; respond within agreed boundaries and route sales enquiries or sensitive issues to the right person.

• Coordinate
 and content campaigns with sales outreach. Maintain consistent messaging and help turn campaign engagement into a useful follow-up.

• Track results, test messaging and formats, and recommend changes. Explain performance using relevant engagement, traffic, enquiry and conversion measures.



Apply SEO and website fundamentals

• Carry out basic keyword and search-intent research. Improve headings, page titles, metadata, internal links, image descriptions and content structure.

• Publish and update pages through a CMS such as WordPress or an equivalent platform. Check links, forms, mobile presentation and basic usability.

• Use tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to understand performance and identify issues. Apply campaign tracking links where appropriate.

• Recognise when specialist development, design or technical SEO support is needed and prepare a clear brief. Advanced web development is outside the core scope.



Required skills and experience

• At least two years of relevant digital marketing experience, with a portfolio showing work you personally created and delivered.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must write accurate, persuasive UK-market content with minimal editing and communicate confidently with colleagues and clients.

• Strong copywriting, editing and content-repurposing skills across web,
 and social channels.

• Practical social media management experience, including planning, scheduling, publishing, community interaction and reporting.

• Sound fundamental knowledge of SEO, website content management and basic web usability.

• Ability to create professional visual content and make straightforward video edits using suitable design and editing tools.

• Working knowledge of analytics, campaign measurement and the difference between audience activity and meaningful business outcomes.

• Good organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage several briefs, deadlines and brand voices without losing quality.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, with clear remote communication and ownership of agreed deliverables.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced marketing company, digital agency or another business delivering work for several clients.

• Experience marketing B2B services, MSP or IT services, professional services or SaaS to UK or Australian audiences.

• Experience with
 marketing, basic marketing automation, CRM handoffs or paid-campaign support. Any advanced paid-media responsibilities will be scoped separately.



What success looks like

Success means accurate, on-brand content is published on time, social channels are managed consistently and campaign reporting leads to practical improvements. We will agree measures around content quality, relevant engagement, search and website performance, enquiries and contribution to the sales pipeline.



Availability and contractor terms

The role is full time, 8 hours per day. However, for the right candidate we can be flexible. Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a portfolio of three to five relevant examples, including written content, social posts and visual work.

• For each example, explain your personal contribution, intended audience and any measurable outcome. Include one SEO or website-content improvement you delivered.

• The content, design, CMS, analytics and social-management tools you use confidently.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD and included weekly hours.



The selection process may include an interview, portfolio discussion and a short content or campaign-planning exercise. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.

title: INDEPENDENT B2B SALES AGENT — COMMISSION ONLY
description:
Tech35 LLC | Lawrenceville, GA | Commercial technology infrastructure



Tech35 LLC sells and deploys business connectivity for commercial customers: business internet, backup/failover internet, Wi-Fi, network equipment, structured cabling, POS/camera/TV connectivity — with onsite activation handled by our installation techs.



THE MISSION



Turn Tech35 commercial opportunities into conversations, meetings, quotes, and closed business. We hand you qualified opportunities. You run the phones.



WHAT THE WORK IS



- Outbound B2B calling to business owners and managers, primarily in Metro Atlanta

- Discovery: ask good questions and understand what the business actually needs

- Objection handling and referral navigation: work past gatekeepers and reach the decision-maker

- Disciplined follow-up: work the queue, log your dispositions, and stay in front of every deal

- Work inside our Revenue OS: call queue, call logs, follow-ups, and performance tracking

- Use company telephony once provisioned

- You sell. Tech35 designs the network and deploys the install techs. No engineering or design work is part of this role.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real B2B phone sales ability: you are comfortable picking up the phone and selling to businesses

- Discovery and objection-handling skill

- Ability to navigate to decision-makers: gatekeepers do not stop you

- Follow-up discipline: you know deals close because someone followed up

- Independence: you manage your own day and your own pipeline

- Professional written and spoken communication

- A reliable computer and internet connection

- Comfort with measurable targets and performance tracking

- Comfort with commission-only, performance-based pay



WHAT WE DO NOT NEED



A degree. A polished resume. A big-name employer on your LinkedIn. If you can sell on the phone, we want to hear from you. A strong seller with an unimpressive resume is welcome here — your record of conversations, meetings, and closes is what counts.



COMPENSATION (commission only — no salary, no hourly)



- 25% of collected gross profit on Tech35-provided (house) leads

- 35% of collected gross profit on self-sourced business

- Carrier/connectivity deals: a defined share of the actual commission or residual Tech35 receives, for a defined period (set before any agreement is signed)

- Paid on collection — not on signature, not on promise

- Chargebacks apply if a customer cancels inside the clawback window

- This is a commission-only, performance-based role. No income is guaranteed and no earnings target is implied or promised. The compensation structure above is owner-approved under policy COMP-0001 v1 (ACTIVATED).



ENGAGEMENT



This is a commission-based independent agent engagement. The engagement classification will be reviewed with legal counsel before any agreement is signed. No legal classification determination is made or implied here.



TO APPLY



Apply at 
 with your name, phone, location, and a short summary of your B2B sales experience. Please do not contact our owner directly about this posting — applications go through the intake page only.



AI USE IN HIRING — DISCLOSURE



AI-assisted tools may be used in screening, assessments, and interviews. Your responses will be evaluated against job-related criteria only (never against protected characteristics). Final hiring decisions are made by a human, not by AI. If you need an accommodation or prefer an alternate evaluation path, say so in your application and we will provide one.

title: Senior Construction Accountant (QuickBooks Online, Job Costing, Catch-Up Work)
description:
We're a US commercial landscape and irrigation contractor working in multiple states. We need a senior accountant who can take full ownership of our accounting with minimal supervision: bring our books current, keep them accurate, and build better financial systems as we grow. This is not an entry-level bookkeeping role.



Your first priority: our books are more than two years behind. You'll lead the catch-up: categorize and reconcile past bank and card activity, clean up AP and AR, fix job costing, and get everything ready for our CPA.



Ongoing responsibilities:

- Day-to-day bookkeeping, plus monthly bank and credit card reconciliations

- Accounts payable: entering vendor bills and scheduling payments

- Invoicing, progress billing, retainage tracking and collections follow-up

- Job costing by project, and reports that show job profitability

- Running payroll for seasonal crews (layoffs and rehires), including certified/prevailing-wage payroll on public jobs

- Working with our QuickBooks Payroll Elite team to keep payroll and payroll taxes compliant in every state we work in

- Multi-state sales and use tax

- Monthly financial statements, and year-end work with our CPA

- Advising on and setting up better processes, controls and reporting



Requirements:

- A degree in accounting or a related field

- 10+ years of hands-on accounting experience (10-20 years preferred), with construction or contractor clients (job costing, progress billing, retainage). E-commerce- or retail-only backgrounds will not be considered.

- At least one large catch-up/cleanup project

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and manage the accounting function without being micromanaged

- Strong QuickBooks Online skills (experience with QBO Advanced is a plus)

- Comfortable with Excel, Google Sheets/Drive, Outlook/Microsoft 365, Adobe Acrobat and bank portals; 
 and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok) are a plus

- At least 2-4 hours of overlap daily with US Mountain Time

- Clear written English and reliable internet



To apply, start with the word "RETAINAGE" and answer:

1. How many years have you worked as an accountant/bookkeeper, and how many of those were with construction or contractor clients? Name the types of contractors.

2. Describe the largest catch-up project you've done: how far behind were the books, and how did you approach it?

3. Tell us about a time job costs in QuickBooks didn't match what actually happened on a project. What was wrong, and how did you fix it?

4. Walk us through how you set up job costing for a contractor client in QuickBooks Online (projects, items, classes, or whatever you used), and why you set it up that way.

5. Have you run certified or prevailing-wage payroll? Which states?

6. What hours (in Philippine time) can you work, and are you looking for full-time or part-time?

7. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

- Request, compare and level subcontractor and supplier quotes

- Help d
 which bids we pursue

We'll train you on our pricing and processes, but you'll own the estimating function.

- 10+ years of construction estimating (general construction is fine; landscape, irrigation or site work is a plus)

- Comfortable with Excel, Adobe Acrobat, 
 and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok)

- At least 2-4 hours of overlap daily with US Mountain Time

title: Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator
description:
Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



About Character Companies



Character Companies is a fast-growing residential homebuilding and real estate development company based in Northern Virginia, USA.



We build new homes throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area and are looking for an exceptional Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator to join our team remotely.



You will work directly with our Pre-Construction Manager and help manage permitting, utilities, consultants, and pre-construction activities across a growing portfolio of residential construction projects.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



This is a project coordination role for someone who is organized, persistent, proactive, comfortable on the phone, and operates with a strong sense of urgency.



Your primary objective will be to help us reduce the amount of time it takes to get our homes permitted and ready for construction.



Our Core Values



Our culture is extremely important to us. Everyone at Character Companies is expected to live our three core values:



FAIL FORWARD

We move quickly, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.



FIGURE IT OUT

We are resourceful. When we encounter a problem, we don't simply report it - we work to find the solution.



FUEL THE VIBE

We bring positive energy, communicate well, support our teammates, and make the people around us better.



These aren't just words on a wall. They influence how we hire, work, evaluate performance, and grow our team.



Your Mission



Drive down our pre-construction and permitting cycle time.



We don't want someone who simply tracks how long things are taking.



We want someone who helps make them take less time.



That requires urgency, organization, persistence, excellent follow-up, and strong communication.



If a permit isn't moving, find out why.



If a reviewer hasn't responded, follow up.



If an engineer owes us a revision, call them.



If a utility application is sitting in a queue, determine what is needed to move it forward.



If you can't solve something yourself, identify the problem clearly and escalate it to our Pre-Construction Manager.



Nothing should sit because nobody followed up.



What You'll Own



Permitting & Government Coordination



Track building, demolition, grading, trade, right-of-way, and other permits across multiple residential projects.



Monitor government permitting portals daily.



Prepare and submit permit applications and supporting documentation.



Track review deadlines, comments, corrections, resubmissions, and approvals.



Call and
 government reviewers to obtain updates and resolve outstanding items.



Coordinate responses between architects, engineers, surveyors, consultants, and our internal team.



Schedule inspections and track corrections through completion.



Maintain accurate documentation of submissions, conversations, approvals, and outstanding requirements.



Utility Coordination



Initiate and track electric, gas, water, sewer, and telecommunications applications.



Communicate directly with U.S. utility companies.



Follow up regarding utility designs, work orders, inspections, meter installations, and service activation.



Track required payments, documents, easements, load information, and approvals.



Identify stalled utility requests and proactively work to get them moving.



Pre-Construction Coordination



Maintain our master pre-construction schedule and tracker across all active projects.



Track architects, engineers, surveys, civil plans, permits, utilities, and other pre-construction deliverables.



Follow up with outside consultants on upcoming and overdue deliverables.



Maintain organized project records and correspondence.



Maintain a database of government reviewers, inspectors, utility representatives, engineers, and consultants.



Identify potential delays before they affect the project schedule.



Provide our Pre-Construction Manager with clear updates on projects requiring his attention.



Phone Communication Is a Major Part of This Position



You must be comfortable picking up the phone.



You will regularly call:



Government permitting departments



Permit reviewers



Utility companies



Architects



Engineers



Surveyors



Consultants



Vendors



Excellent spoken English is therefore extremely important.



We're looking for someone who can confidently and professionally have a conversation, ask good questions, obtain clear answers, and respectfully push for the next action.



If you strongly prefer communicating only through
 or messaging, this position will not be a good fit.



Who We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented



Highly responsive with a strong sense of urgency



Persistent without being unprofessional



Proactive and resourceful



An excellent English speaker



A strong written communicator



Confident making outbound phone calls



Comfortable managing many projects and deadlines simultaneously



Comfortable learning unfamiliar processes



Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense



Able to identify problems and propose solutions



Comfortable holding outside consultants accountable to deadlines



Able to determine when an issue needs to be escalated



We especially value people who naturally think:



"What can I do to move this forward today?"



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly valuable:



U.S. residential construction



Homebuilding



Construction project coordination



Permitting



Architecture or engineering



Utility coordination



Real estate development



Construction administration



Working remotely for a U.S.-based construction company



Previous U.S. permitting experience is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly and demonstrates strong ownership.



Technology



You should be highly comfortable using technology and learning new software.



Our team uses platforms including:



JobTread



CompanyCam



Google Workspace



Microsoft Office



Government permitting portals



Utility provider portals



Cloud-based project management systems



How We Will Measure Success



This is an outcomes-driven position.



We will measure things including:



Permit cycle time



Days from submission to approval



Speed of responses to review comments



Outstanding permit items



Utility application and activation timelines



Consultant turnaround times



Accuracy of project tracking



Number of issues proactively identified and resolved



Ultimately, your performance comes down to one question:



Are our projects moving through pre-construction faster and more predictably because you're here?



Schedule



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



You must be willing to work primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours because you will communicate directly with U.S. government agencies, utility companies, consultants, and our internal team.



Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.



We are looking for a long-term team member with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as Character Companies continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a short cover letter answering the questions below.



Generic or AI-generated cover letters that do not specifically answer these questions will not be considered.



1. Driving Down Permit Cycle Time



Your primary responsibility is to help Character Companies reduce the amount of time it takes to move a new home through permitting and into construction.



If you were given responsibility for 20 residential projects in various stages of permitting, what specific actions and systems would you implement to drive our average permitting cycle time down?



Be specific. We want to understand how you think.



2. Sense of Urgency



Tell us about a previous situation where something was delayed or wasn't moving quickly enough.



What did you personally do to move it forward?



3. Phone Communication



This position requires frequent outbound calls to U.S. government agencies, utility companies, engineers, architects, and consultants.



Describe your experience making professional outbound phone calls in English. Are you comfortable calling someone repeatedly when necessary to obtain an answer or move something forward?



4. Organization



Imagine you're responsible for tracking 20 projects, 40+ permit applications, multiple utility applications, and several outside consultants.



How would you organize your work so that nothing gets missed?



5. Figure It Out



You call a government permitting department about an application that hasn't moved in two weeks. The person tells you:



"It's still under review. Someone will contact you when it's ready."



What would you do next?



6. Relevant Experience



Tell us about any experience you have with:



Construction



Permitting



Project coordination



Utilities



Architecture/engineering



Real estate development



U.S.-based companies



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and confirm that you are available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

title: Video Ad Editor For Facebook Brand
description:
# Full-Time AI Ad Video Editor / 
 Video Maker for
 Ads



We are looking for a full-time video ad maker who specializes in creating high-quality direct response video ads, VSLs, AI UGC-style videos, and b-roll ads for
 advertising.



This is not a basic editing job.



We need someone who can take a finished script, find strong b-roll clips, generate realistic AI human clips, create scroll-stopping visuals, and turn the video into a high-quality ad that feels engaging, believable, and professional.



You will be working on video sales letters, short-form b-roll ads, and AI UGC ads for our brand.



## What You’ll Be Making



You will help create:



* Video Sales Letters/VSLs that are usually 7 to 15 minutes long

* Short-form
 ad videos

* AI UGC-style ads with realistic human clips

* B-roll ads using stock footage, online clips, and AI-generated visuals

* Direct response ads designed to hold attention and drive sales



We will provide the scripts for sure and voiceovers if needed.



Your job is to bring the ad to life visually.



That means choosing the right clips, pacing the edit properly, adding strong visuals, using AI-generated clips when needed, and making the final video feel polished and professional.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Editing full VSL videos from provided scripts and voiceovers

* Finding relevant b-roll clips that match the script

* Creating high-quality AI-generated clips of realistic humans

* Making AI UGC-style ad videos

* Creating short-form b-roll ads for

* Adding captions, visual transitions, zooms, overlays, and pacing that keep attention

* Matching the style and quality of reference videos we provide

* Delivering consistent, high-quality ads every week

* Communicating clearly and meeting deadlines



## Requirements



You must have experience with:



* Video editing for ads, VSLs, or direct response content

* Creating realistic AI-generated video clips of humans

* Finding and using strong b-roll footage

* Editing videos that are meant to sell, not just look nice

* Making videos for
, TikTok, Instagram Reels, or similar platforms

* Understanding pacing, hooks, retention, and visual storytelling

* Fluent English communication



You must also be reliable, consistent, detail-oriented, and able to follow creative direction.



## Tools/Skills That Are A Plus



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* CapCut

* Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Runway

* Kling

* Seedance

* VEO

* Pika

* Midjourney

* ElevenLabs

* Canva

* Descript

* AI video generation tools

* Stock footage websites

* Direct response advertising

*
 ad creative



You do not need to use these exact tools, but you must be able to produce high-quality video ads.



## Portfolio Required



Please do not apply without a portfolio.



When you apply, send examples of:



* VSLs you have edited

* AI-generated video clips you have created

* UGC-style ads

*
/TikTok ad videos

* Any direct response video ads you have made



We will also provide a Google Drive link with examples of videos we have made. You should review these videos before applying and only apply if you believe you can match or improve the quality.



Google Drive Reference Link: 





## Work Schedule



This is a full-time position.



You will have weekends off.



We are looking for someone who can work consistently during the week and communicate clearly.



## Trial Phase



Every hire will start with a 2-week trial phase.



The purpose of this trial is to see if you are the right fit for the role.



During the 2-week trial, you will be expected to create as many high-quality video ads as possible while maintaining strong quality and consistency.



At the end of the 2-week trial, we will review:



* The quality of your edits

* Your consistency

* Your ability to follow instructions

* Your speed

* Your communication

* Your ability to create ads that match our style



You will receive a payout at the end of the 2-week trial based on the quality and consistency of the ads completed.



After the trial phase, if you are a good fit, we will move into a long-term full-time role and negotiate a strong monthly salary paid bi-weekly.



## Growth Opportunity



This role has a lot of room to grow.



We are looking for someone long-term.



Bonuses will be available for consistency, strong performance, and ads that perform well for the brand.



If you are reliable, creative, and able to consistently produce high-quality video ads, this can become a very strong long-term position.



## How To Apply



To apply, please send:



1. A short intro about yourself and your experience

2. Your portfolio of video ads or VSLs

3. Examples of AI-generated human video clips you have created

4. The tools you use for editing and AI video generation

5. Your expected monthly salary for a full-time role

6. Confirmation that you are available full-time and fluent in English



Also answer this question:



After reviewing our Google Drive examples, do you believe you can match or improve this video quality? If yes, explain why.



We are only looking for experienced video ad creators. Please do not apply if you only have basic editing experience.

title: Mortgage Broker Assistant (Loan Processor) – Australian Residential Lending – Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established mortgage broking firm based in Adelaide, South Australia. We help clients across Australia with residential home loans, mostly refinances, purchases and pre-approvals, plus some other lending. Our head broker has 7 years of broking experience and focuses on bringing in business, while our support team takes each file from the point a client commits through to settlement.

We are growing and are looking for a reliable, experienced assistant to join the team on a long-term, stable basis.



THE ROLE

You will work alongside our in-house team and take ownership of loan files from start to finish. Once a client has committed and documents are in, the file is yours to run, with the broker overseeing along the way. You will manage around 15-20 files at a time, and sometimes more, and help support our in-house staff where needed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



 • Run borrowing capacity and serviceability scenarios and shop lender options using Quickli

 • Assess client income and prepare scenarios across multiple lenders

 • Build loan applications in Apply Online and our CRMs

 • Collect and check all required client documents so each application is complete and correct

 • Prepare and lodge loan applications with lenders

 • Get forms and disclosures signed by clients

 • Liaise with clients, banks and BDMs from lodgement through to settlement

 • Follow up on conditions, additional information requests and valuations

 • Keep every deal on track against client and settlement deadlines

 • Keep client records and file notes accurate and up to date in HubSpot and MyCRM

 • Provide friendly, professional customer service by phone,
 and messaging

 • Communicate clearly with the broker and team in Slack



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



 • Proven experience processing or lodging residential mortgages for Australian lenders, including dealing directly with banks and clients (we need someone who can hit the ground running)

 • Hands-on experience building applications in Apply Online or a similar mortgage application platform

 • Working knowledge of Australian lending concepts: serviceability, living expenses, documentation requirements, pre-approvals, refinancing and settlement processes

 • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to spot missing or inconsistent documents before lodgement

 • Excellent written and spoken English

 • Able to manage multiple files at once and prioritise deadlines without close supervision

 • Strong customer service skills, with a calm, professional manner with clients and lenders

 • Comfortable handling confidential client financial information and following security procedures (strong passwords, multi-factor authentication, no sharing of logins or documents outside our systems)

 • Reliable high-speed internet with a backup option (mobile data, secondary connection or power backup), plus a quiet, dedicated workspace and your own working computer



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



 • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

 • Experience with MyCRM

 • Experience with Quickli or other mortgage scenario and borrowing capacity tools

 • Experience working with Australian banks, non-bank lenders and BDMs

 • Previous customer service or client-facing experience

 • Familiarity with Slack and remote team collaboration



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



We will train you on our own processes, systems and standards, so you do not need to know everything on day one. We want someone who already understands mortgage processing and can get up to speed quickly. You will have direct access to the broker and the in-house team.



WHAT WE OFFER



 • Full-time, long-term, stable role with an established Australian company

 • Opportunity to grow within the company

 • Supportive team and clear processes

 • Modern tools, including AI-assisted scenario tools



WORKING HOURS



Full-time, Monday to Friday, with hours that overlap Adelaide business hours. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the words "Lodgement Experience" so we know you've read this post. Then send:

 1. Your resume

 2. A short summary of your experience with Australian mortgage lodgements, including which lenders and platforms you have used

 3. The systems you are experienced with (Apply Online, HubSpot, MyCRM, Quickli or similar)

 4. Roughly how many files you managed at one time in your last role

 5. Your availability and expected rate

 6. A screenshot of your internet speed test and a short description of your backup internet and power setup



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a short practical task. 



Applications that do not follow these steps may not be reviewed.



Salary can vary depending on your skills and experience. Strictly looking for someone who has existing experience in Australian mortgage broking. 



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: AI Chief of Staff — Build and Run AI Systems Alongside the Principa
description:
**AI Chief of Staff — Build and Run AI Systems Alongside the Principal**



**Job Overview**



Australian professional services principal (CFO advisory and a migration agency; firm names disclosed to shortlisted candidates) looking for one person to work directly with me, every day, to build and operate AI across my businesses and my personal workflow.



This is not a project role with a fixed scope. It is a daily working partnership. We will pair for one to two hours most mornings (UTC+8 — Philippines time) and you will carry the work forward during the day. You will build agent teams in Claude Code and Grok, set up the automations around them, develop new AI-based products with me, and — critically — teach me as we go so that I can extend and run everything myself.



I am a CPA who uses Claude Code daily. I know what I want built. I need someone who can build it faster than I can, explain it clearly, and challenge my thinking.



**What You Will Work On**



Agent teams for my CFO advisory firm — client bookkeeping review, month-end packs, workpapers, client correspondence.



Agent teams for my migration agency — enquiry handling, document checklists, case preparation and client follow-up.



A personal operating system — calendar,
, task and knowledge management, so my day runs through AI rather than around it.



New products — turning the internal systems above into packaged offerings we can take to market.



Ongoing: documenting everything so the business is never dependent on one person.



**Requirements**



Hands-on with Claude Code (subagents, CLAUDE.md, skill files, MCP) and at least one other frontier model platform (Grok, OpenAI or Gemini). You can show working systems you have built.



Python or TypeScript to a working standard; Git daily; comfortable with APIs, OAuth and webhooks (Xero and Microsoft 365 a strong plus).



A genuine teacher. You can explain a technical decision to a smart non-engineer, live, without jargon — and you enjoy it.



Strong product sense. You will be expected to push back, suggest better approaches and bring ideas, not just take instructions.



Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable on a daily video or voice call.



Available Mon–Fri during UTC+8 business hours; reliable internet and backup power.



**Nice to Have**



n8n, Make or Zapier; Supabase/Postgres; Microsoft Graph API. Any exposure to accounting, bookkeeping or immigration processes. Open-model experience for cost-sensitive workloads.



**How We Work**



Daily pairing session, then independent build time. Weekly written goals and a Friday demo. Everything in Git with a README. Secrets in a vault, never in chat. All IP assigned to the firm under a contractor agreement and NDA. Shortlisted candidates complete a paid four-hour test build; the successful candidate starts on a paid 30-day trial.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Camera Fleet Platform (Full-time, Long-term)
description:
About us



We build and operate CCTV for construction sites across Australia. We build the hardware and we build the software that runs it — live view, playback, alarm monitoring, onboarding, billing. Hundreds of cameras and 4G routers in the field, one platform running all of them.



The role



The platform is currently run by a core engineering team. You'll own real parts of the system end to end — write it, ship it, watch it run.



The work is broad: REST APIs and React one day, a camera that won't stream the next, a router dropping its VPN the day after. There's no separate devops or QA team. If that sounds like a mess, it's not for you. If it sounds interesting, keep reading.



Stack



Python 3.12 / FastAPI, React, MariaDB, self-hosted Linux (systemd, nginx), WireGuard, 4G routers, IP cameras over RTSP and ONVIF, WebRTC streaming.



What we need



Strong Python in production — you understand async, blocking calls, connection pools

Solid JavaScript or TypeScript, and you've shipped frontends

Real Linux experience — SSH into a sick server and work out what's wrong

Networking: NAT, VPNs, routing, firewalls. A lot of our debugging lives here

Willingness to work things out when there's no documentation. This matters more than any specific skill on this list



Nice to have (not required — we'll teach you if you are really smart)



RTSP, ONVIF, WebRTC, ffmpeg. CCTV hardware — Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview. 4G/LTE routers. LLM tool-use APIs.



What we're not



No big team, no product manager, no ticket queue. Some weeks are new features, some are firefighting. We want someone smart and curious, not someone who needs a spec handed to them.

title: EXPERIENCED QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP BOOKKEEPER – U.S. HOURS REQUIRED
description:
IMPORTANT: This position requires extensive hands-on experience with QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP and the ability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM, with a break for lunch.



If your bookkeeping experience is primarily QuickBooks Online using automated bank feeds and imported transactions, this position is probably not the right fit.



We need someone who is highly proficient in QuickBooks Desktop and comfortable performing traditional bookkeeping, including MANUALLY ENTERING transactions from bank statements and credit card statements when necessary.



WORK HOURS:



• Must be available to work 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time



• Break for lunch



• You must be consistently available and actively working during these hours



Responsibilities include:



• Entering transactions from bank and credit card statements into QuickBooks Desktop



• Properly coding transactions to general ledger accounts



• Reconciling bank and credit card accounts



• Reviewing the general ledger and identifying incorrect, duplicate, or missing transactions



• Preparing and maintaining accurate bookkeeping records



• Communicating clearly with our accounting team regarding missing information, discrepancies, and questions



Required Qualifications:



• Minimum 4 years of bookkeeping experience



• STRONG QuickBooks Desktop experience is REQUIRED



• Experience manually entering transactions from bank and credit card statements into QuickBooks Desktop



• QuickBooks Online experience is helpful, but QuickBooks Desktop proficiency is significantly more important for this position



• Strong working knowledge of accounting principles and practices



• Solid understanding of debits, credits, general ledger accounts, and proper transaction classification



• Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations



• Excellent attention to detail



• Ability to learn and become proficient with new software applications



• Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple client assignments



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



• Two monitors are preferable for efficiency when working between QuickBooks Desktop and source documents



This is not simply a data-import position. We are specifically looking for an experienced bookkeeper who understands the accounting behind the entries and can work from actual bank and credit card statements when transactions cannot simply be downloaded or imported.



Cannabis accounting experience is NOT required. We can teach the industry-specific accounting requirements. Strong bookkeeping fundamentals and extensive QuickBooks Desktop experience are much more important.



PLEASE INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING WITH YOUR APPLICATION:



How many years have you worked with QuickBooks Desktop?

Have you manually entered an entire month of transactions into QuickBooks Desktop directly from bank and/or credit card statements?

Are you comfortable determining the appropriate general ledger account for transactions rather than simply accepting imported classifications?

What experience do you have with bank and credit card reconciliations?

Are you able to consistently work from 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with a break for lunch?



Please begin your proposal with the words "QUICKBOOKS DESKTOP" so we know you have read the entire posting.

title: Performance Marketer — Google + Meta Ads & CRM Tracking
description:
Please start your application with the subject line or first sentence: "I am Axya's next Performance Marketer." Applications without this exact phrase will be archived unread.





Company: Axya Global  

Location: Remote  

Hours: Approximately 12-15 hours per week, with daily campaign monitoring. Requires 1–2 hours of daily overlap with Toronto (EST) business hours for team syncs and campaign checks

Engagement: Ongoing part-time role, starting with a paid 90-day engagement  

Compensation: 9-12 USD/hr to start during the 90-day trial, with a performance/skill-based review upon moving to a permanent role. Invoice end of week showing hours logged. Paid via Wise

- 



About Axya



Axya Global is a real estate and development company based in Toronto, Canada. We market pre-construction homes in the Greater Toronto Area, where competition is intense and qualified buyers matter.



Our ambition goes beyond selling properties. We want to understand how people live and help deliver homes that feel like an extension of them. Our long-term vision includes advancing construction through innovative modular and deployable structures.



We are looking for a performance marketer who brings strong judgment, takes ownership, and has a tremendous appetite to learn.



Your mission



Build and improve the system connecting our advertising, CRM, qualified appointments, and sales.



You should proactively identify opportunities, recommend changes, and execute within agreed budgets. We want someone who notices problems and opportunities before we have to point them out.



What you will own



- Google and Meta advertising: Build, launch, monitor, and improve campaigns. Manage targeting, search terms, negative keywords, bidding, budget pacing, ad copy, and creative testing.

- CRM feedback: Connect acquisition data and meaningful lead outcomes in Follow Up Boss to Google and Meta. Implement and validate tracking, working with specialist support where necessary.

- Funnel analysis: Identify where leads drop off between registration, contact, qualification, appointments, and sales. Work with our sales team to distinguish advertising problems from follow-up problems.

- Competitive research: Study competing ads, landing pages, messaging, and offers. Turn findings into practical opportunities for Axya.

- Testing and reporting: Maintain a prioritized testing plan and explain what changed, why, what happened, and what should happen next.



What we are looking for



- Proven hands-on experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads for lead generation.

- Evidence of improving lead quality and downstream outcomes.

- Experience building or improving landing pages.

- Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, enhanced conversions for leads, Meta Conversions API, and CRM attribution.

- Experience implementing a CRM-to-ad-platform feedback loop beyond basic form-submission tracking.

- Strong written English and the ability to explain decisions clearly.

- Independent prioritization, dependable communication, and agreed overlap with EST working hours.



Experience with real estate, mortgages, home services, or other high-value purchases involving an offline sales process is valuable. Follow Up Boss, n8n, Make, Zapier, and API/webhook experience are advantages.



Learning and initiative matter



We expect you to stay current with platform changes, measurement developments, creative approaches, and useful tools.



Bring us ideas, explain the reasoning, and test them responsibly. Know when the evidence supports a change and when more data is needed.



We care about your ability to learn, apply, measure, and improve—not simply name the latest feature or tool.



How we will assess success



- Reliable tracking and clear visibility into lead quality.

- Better cost per qualified lead and qualified attended appointment.

- Acquisition costs that make sense.

- Useful experiments and proactive recommendations.

- Less founder involvement in routine advertising work.



How to apply



Include while applying:



1. Two relevant campaign examples: budget, timeframe, results, and your personal contribution.

2. A short explanation of a CRM feedback loop you implemented and how you verified it worked.

3. One thing you learned in the last 90 days, how you applied it, and what happened.





Keep examples specific. Anonymize confidential client information.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical assessment using anonymized information or read-only access.
